rank now: the dashboard reads interp.rank, and an unranked\n # set leaves every rank None so \"best\" silently becomes\n # \"first parsed\"\n rank_interpretations(interps)\n out[\"ves_results\"] = (kept, results, interps)\n ok.append(ves_key)\n else:\n issues.append(_issue(\n ves_key, \"ves_results\", \"analysis_error\",\n \"No sounding in the geophysics workbook could be inverted, \"\n \"so there are no VES results to show.\",\n context=ves_path.name,\n ))\n\n pump_path = _path(\"pump\")\n if pump_path is not None:\n try:\n reader = (\n read_pumping_docx\n if pump_path.suffix.lower() == \".docx\"\n else read_pumping_workbook\n )\n test = reader(pump_path)\n except Exception as exc: # noqa: BLE001\n _log.exception(\"pumping test could not be parsed\")\n test = None\n issues.append(_issue(\n \"pump\", \"pump_analysis\", \"parse_error\",\n \"The pumping test sheet could not be read, so the drawdown and \"\n \"yield results were not restored.\",\n context=pump_path.name, exc=exc,\n ))\n if test is not None:\n try:\n for step in test.steps:\n q = discharges.get(str(step.step_number))\n if q:\n step.discharge_m3_per_h = float(q)\n out[\"pump_analysis\"] = analyse_pumping_test(test, config.pumping)\n ok.append(\"pump\")\n except Exception as exc: # noqa: BLE001\n _log.exception(\"pumping test could not be analysed\")\n issues.append(_issue(\n \"pump\", \"pump_analysis\", \"analysis_error\",\n \"The pumping test sheet was read but the analysis failed, \"\n \"so there is no transmissivity or yield recommendation.\",\n context=pump_path.name, exc=exc,\n ))\n\n wq_path = _path(\"wq\")\n if wq_path is not None:\n try:\n sample = read_quality_workbook(wq_path)\n except Exception as exc: # noqa: BLE001\n _log.exception(\"water quality workbook could not be parsed\")\n sample = None\n issues.append(_issue(\n \"wq\", \"wq_assessment\", \"parse_error\",\n \"The water quality workbook could not be read, so no \"\n \"suitability verdict was restored. Do not treat the absence of \"\n \"a verdict as a pass.\",\n context=wq_path.name, exc=exc,\n ))\n if sample is not None:\n try:\n out[\"wq_assessment\"] = assess_sample(sample)\n ok.append(\"wq\")\n except Exception as exc: # noqa: BLE001\n _log.exception(\"water quality sample could not be assessed\")\n issues.append(_issue(\n \"wq\", \"wq_assessment\", \"analysis_error\",\n \"The laboratory results were read but could not be assessed \"\n \"against the standards, so there is no verdict. Do not \"\n \"treat the absence of a verdict as a pass.\",\n context=wq_path.name, exc=exc,\n ))\n\n log_path = _path(\"log\")\n if log_path is not None:\n try:\n log = read_drilling_workbook(log_path)\n except Exception as exc: # noqa: BLE001\n _log.exception(\"drilling log could not be parsed\")\n log = None\n issues.append(_issue(\n \"log\", \"drilling_log\", \"parse_error\",\n \"The drilling log could not be read, so the lithology and the \"\n \"borehole design were not restored.\",\n context=log_path.name, exc=exc,\n ))\n if log is not None:\n out[\"drilling_log\"] = log\n ok.append(\"log\")\n try:\n out[\"borehole_design\"] = design_borehole(\n log=log,\n static_water_level_m=design_swl or None,\n rules=config.design,\n )\n except Exception as exc: # noqa: BLE001\n _log.exception(\"borehole design could not be derived\")\n issues.append(_issue(\n \"log\", \"borehole_design\", \"analysis_error\",\n \"The drilling log was read but the borehole design could \"\n \"not be derived from it, so the screen layout and the bill \"\n \"of quantities are missing.\",\n context=log_path.name, exc=exc, level=\"warning\",\n ))\n\n # Always present, so loading a second project clears the first one's\n # banner rather than leaving a stale one on screen.\n out[\"recompute_diagnostics\"] = {\n \"ok\": ok,\n \"issues\": [issue.as_dict() for issue in issues],\n }\n return out\n"}, "groundwater/registry.py": {"t": "text", "d": "\"\"\"The borehole as an asset, not as a project.\n\nA drilling project ends. The borehole does not: it is pumped every day for\ntwenty years by people who were not there when it was drilled, and the\nquestion that matters after handover is not \"what did the pumping test say\"\nbut \"is it working, when was it last looked at, and when was the water last\ntested\". The completion report cannot answer that, because it was written\nonce and never touched again.\n\nSo this module holds the other half. An asset has a stable identifier that\nsurvives the project file, a position, and an append-only stream of events -\ncommissioned, inspected, sampled, broken down, repaired, abandoned. From\nthat stream it derives what is true today: whether the point is working,\nhow long it has been out, and what is now overdue.\n\nThree things shape the design.\n\n**Offline first.** Field updates are recorded on a phone at the wellhead\nwith no signal, often by two people who each write the visit down. Events\nare therefore identified by their content rather than by a counter, so the\nsame visit recorded twice merges into one, and a merge is a set union that\nneeds no server to arbitrate it.\n\n**Append-only.** A maintenance record that can be edited is a maintenance\nrecord nobody can rely on. A mistake is corrected by recording the\ncorrection, which leaves both in the history where an auditor can see them.\n\n**Nothing is assumed working.** An asset with no events is ``unknown``, not\n``functional``. A failure with no recorded repair stays a failure. The\ncommon way an asset register becomes useless is that absence of bad news\ngets read as good news, and after two years everything is green.\n\"\"\"\n\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport re\nfrom dataclasses import dataclass, field\nfrom datetime import date, timedelta\n\nfrom .geo import infer_zone_for_sierra_leone, utm_to_geographic\n\n__all__ = [\n \"Asset\",\n \"AssetEvent\",\n \"AssetState\",\n \"DISTRICT_CODES\",\n \"EVENT_KINDS\",\n \"FUNCTION_LABELS\",\n \"Schedule\",\n \"asset_from_project\",\n \"asset_state\",\n \"check_character\",\n \"event_id\",\n \"format_asset_id\",\n \"merge_events\",\n \"mint_asset_id\",\n \"parse_asset_id\",\n \"placard_lines\",\n \"qr_payload\",\n \"registry_rows\",\n \"registry_stats\",\n \"validate_asset_id\",\n]\n\n\n# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n# The identifier\n# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\n#: Crockford's base 32: no I, L, O or U, so nothing in a code can be confused\n#: with 1, 0 or V when it is read off a plate or repeated over a radio.\n_ALPHABET = \"0123456789ABCDEFGHJKMNPQRSTVWXYZ\"\n\n#: What a reader who writes I, L, O or U anyway almost certainly meant.\n_FOLD = {\"I\": \"1\", \"L\": \"1\", \"O\": \"0\", \"U\": \"V\"}\n\n#: The check character is ISO 7064 MOD 37,36, whose alphabet is the full 36.\n_CHECK_ALPHABET = \"0123456789ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ\"\n\n#: District codes. Written out rather than derived, for the same reason the\n#: site statuses are: a rule that produces \"BO\" for Bo and \"BOM\" for Bombali\n#: today produces a collision the first time a district is renamed, and a\n#: collision here means two boreholes with one identifier.\nDISTRICT_CODES = {\n \"western area urban\": \"WAU\",\n \"western area rural\": \"WAR\",\n \"port loko\": \"PL\",\n \"kambia\": \"KAM\",\n \"karene\": \"KAR\",\n \"bombali\": \"BOM\",\n \"falaba\": \"FAL\",\n \"koinadugu\": \"KOI\",\n \"tonkolili\": \"TON\",\n \"kono\": \"KON\",\n \"kenema\": \"KEN\",\n \"kailahun\": \"KAI\",\n \"bo\": \"BO\",\n \"bonthe\": \"BON\",\n \"moyamba\": \"MOY\",\n \"pujehun\": \"PUJ\",\n}\n\n#: A district nobody could match. Deliberately not a guess: an identifier\n#: that says XX is one somebody can fix, and it still locates the borehole.\nUNKNOWN_DISTRICT = \"XX\"\n\n#: Positions are quantised to this before they go into the identifier.\nPOSITION_STEP_M = 10\n\n_ID_RE = re.compile(r\"^SL-([A-Z]{2,4})-([0-9A-Z]{7})-([0-9A-Z])$\")\n\n\ndef check_character(body: str) -> str:\n \"\"\"ISO 7064 MOD 37,36 over ``body``, ignoring separators.\n\n Chosen over a simpler weighted sum because it detects every single\n wrong character and every transposition of two adjacent ones - which\n between them are almost all the mistakes people make copying a code off\n a headworks plate into a phone.\n \"\"\"\n product = 36\n for char in body.upper():\n value = _CHECK_ALPHABET.find(char)\n if value < 0:\n continue # separators and spaces carry no value\n total = (product % 37) + value\n product = 2 * (total % 37 or 37)\n return _CHECK_ALPHABET[(37 - product % 37) % 36]\n\n\ndef _position_code(easting: float, northing: float, zone: int) -> str:\n \"\"\"Seven characters holding the position to the nearest ten metres.\n\n Derived rather than allocated, because there is no server to allocate\n from: two teams standing at the same wellhead with no connection between\n them have to arrive at the same identifier.\n \"\"\"\n east = int(round(float(easting) / POSITION_STEP_M))\n north = int(round(float(northing) / POSITION_STEP_M))\n if not 0 <= east < 1 << 17 or not 0 <= north < 1 << 17:\n raise ValueError(\n f\"({easting}, {northing}) is not a position inside Sierra Leone; \"\n \"an identifier minted from it would not be findable\"\n )\n value = ((1 if int(zone) == 29 else 0) << 34) | (east << 17) | north\n return \"\".join(_ALPHABET[(value >> shift) & 31]\n for shift in range(30, -1, -5))\n\n\ndef _district_code(district: str) -> str:\n return DISTRICT_CODES.get(str(district or \"\").strip().lower(),\n UNKNOWN_DISTRICT)\n\n\ndef format_asset_id(district_code: str, position_code: str) -> str:\n body = f\"SL-{district_code}-{position_code}\"\n return f\"{body}-{check_character(body)}\"\n\n\ndef mint_asset_id(site) -> str:\n \"\"\"The identifier for a borehole at ``site``.\n\n Minted once, at commissioning, and carried from then on. A later GPS fix\n a few metres off the first one produces a different code, which is why\n the registry matches on the recorded identifier first and on proximity\n only as a fallback - the derivation is how the first identifier is made\n and how a lost one is reconstructed, not something to re-run each visit.\n \"\"\"\n easting = getattr(site, \"easting\", None)\n northing = getattr(site, \"northing\", None)\n if easting is None or northing is None:\n raise ValueError(\n \"a borehole with no recorded position cannot be given an \"\n \"identifier: there would be nothing to find it by\"\n )\n zone = getattr(site, \"utm_zone\", None) or infer_zone_for_sierra_leone(\n float(easting))\n return format_asset_id(_district_code(getattr(site, \"district\", \"\")),\n _position_code(easting, northing, zone))\n\n\ndef parse_asset_id(text: str) -> str | None:\n \"\"\"Normalise a hand-entered identifier, or ``None`` if it is not one.\n\n Case, spacing and the four Crockford confusions (I and L for 1, O for 0,\n U for V) are forgiven in the position code, because they are reading\n mistakes rather than different codes. A failing check character is not\n forgiven: that is a wrong identifier, and a wrong identifier attaches a\n maintenance history to somebody else's borehole.\n \"\"\"\n raw = re.sub(r\"[\\s_]+\", \"\", str(text or \"\")).upper().replace(\"\u2013\", \"-\")\n if not raw:\n return None\n if not raw.startswith(\"SL-\"):\n raw = \"SL-\" + raw\n parts = raw.split(\"-\")\n if len(parts) != 4:\n return None\n _, district, code, given = parts\n code = \"\".join(_FOLD.get(c, c) for c in code)\n given = _FOLD.get(given, given)\n candidate = f\"SL-{district}-{code}-{given}\"\n if not _ID_RE.match(candidate):\n return None\n if check_character(f\"SL-{district}-{code}\") != given:\n return None\n return candidate\n\n\ndef validate_asset_id(text: str) -> tuple[bool, str]:\n \"\"\"``(ok, reason)`` - the reason is written to be shown to the person typing.\"\"\"\n raw = str(text or \"\").strip()\n if not raw:\n return False, \"No identifier was entered.\"\n parsed = parse_asset_id(raw)\n if parsed:\n return True, \"\"\n tidy = re.sub(r\"[\\s_]+\", \"\", raw.upper())\n if not tidy.startswith(\"SL-\"):\n tidy = \"SL-\" + tidy\n parts = tidy.split(\"-\")\n if len(parts) != 4:\n return False, (\"An identifier looks like SL-WAR-8T4KQ2A-7: country, \"\n \"district, position, check character.\")\n _, district, code, given = parts\n code = \"\".join(_FOLD.get(c, c) for c in code)\n if not re.fullmatch(r\"[0-9A-Z]{7}\", code):\n return False, \"The position part should be seven letters or digits.\"\n expected = check_character(f\"SL-{district}-{code}\")\n return False, (\n f\"The check character does not match: this identifier should end in \"\n f\"{expected}, not {given}. Something in it has been mistyped.\")\n\n\n# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n# Events\n# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\n#: kind -> (label, what it establishes about function, is it a service visit)\nEVENT_KINDS = {\n \"commissioned\": (\"Commissioned\", \"functional\", False),\n \"inspection\": (\"Sanitary inspection\", None, True),\n \"water_sample\": (\"Water sampled\", None, False),\n \"repair\": (\"Repair\", \"functional\", True),\n \"failure\": (\"Failure\", \"non_functional\", True),\n \"restored\": (\"Returned to service\", \"functional\", True),\n \"decommissioned\": (\"Decommissioned\", \"decommissioned\", False),\n \"note\": (\"Note\", None, False),\n}\n\nFUNCTION_LABELS = {\n \"functional\": \"Working\",\n \"non_functional\": \"Not working\",\n \"decommissioned\": \"Decommissioned\",\n \"unknown\": \"Not known\",\n}\n\n\ndef _hash32(text: str) -> int:\n \"\"\"FNV-1a. Small, deterministic, and the same four lines in any language.\"\"\"\n value = 0x811C9DC5\n for char in text:\n value = ((value ^ (ord(char) & 0xFF)) * 0x01000193) & 0xFFFFFFFF\n return value\n\n\ndef event_id(asset_id: str, when: str, kind: str, note: str = \"\",\n by: str = \"\") -> str:\n \"\"\"A content-derived identifier, so recording a visit twice merges to one.\n\n Two people at the same wellhead writing down the same repair on the same\n day produce the same event, and a union of their phones has one entry\n rather than two. The cost is that two genuinely separate events with\n identical wording on the same day also collapse - which is the right way\n round: a duplicated record is a lie about how much maintenance happened.\n \"\"\"\n digest = _hash32(f\"{asset_id}|{when}|{kind}|{note.strip()}|{by.strip()}\")\n tail = \"\".join(_ALPHABET[(digest >> shift) & 31] for shift in (15, 10, 5, 0))\n return f\"{when}/{kind}/{tail}\"\n\n\n@dataclass\nclass AssetEvent:\n \"\"\"One thing that happened to a borehole.\"\"\"\n\n when: str # ISO date; kept as written so a bad one is visible\n kind: str\n note: str = \"\"\n by: str = \"\"\n photo: str = \"\" # a data URL or a path; opaque here\n event_id: str = \"\"\n\n def identified_for(self, asset_id: str) -> \"AssetEvent\":\n \"\"\"A copy carrying its content-derived id.\"\"\"\n return AssetEvent(\n when=self.when, kind=self.kind, note=self.note, by=self.by,\n photo=self.photo,\n event_id=self.event_id or event_id(asset_id, self.when, self.kind,\n self.note, self.by),\n )\n\n @property\n def label(self) -> str:\n return EVENT_KINDS.get(self.kind, (\"Other\", None, False))[0]\n\n @property\n def date(self) -> date | None:\n \"\"\"The date, or ``None`` when it cannot be read.\n\n An event whose date is unreadable is kept - throwing away a\n maintenance record because of a typo is worse - but it can never\n establish when anything last happened.\n \"\"\"\n try:\n return date.fromisoformat(str(self.when).strip())\n except (TypeError, ValueError):\n return None\n\n def as_dict(self) -> dict:\n return {\"when\": self.when, \"kind\": self.kind, \"note\": self.note,\n \"by\": self.by, \"photo\": self.photo, \"event_id\": self.event_id}\n\n\ndef _coerce_event(raw) -> AssetEvent | None:\n if isinstance(raw, AssetEvent):\n return raw\n if not isinstance(raw, dict):\n return None\n kind = str(raw.get(\"kind\") or \"\").strip()\n if kind not in EVENT_KINDS:\n kind = \"note\"\n return AssetEvent(\n when=str(raw.get(\"when\") or \"\").strip(), kind=kind,\n note=str(raw.get(\"note\") or \"\"), by=str(raw.get(\"by\") or \"\"),\n photo=str(raw.get(\"photo\") or \"\"),\n event_id=str(raw.get(\"event_id\") or \"\"),\n )\n\n\ndef merge_events(asset_id: str, *streams) -> list[AssetEvent]:\n \"\"\"Union of several event streams, in date order.\n\n This is the whole offline story. Two phones that have been out of touch\n for a fortnight each hold part of the history; merging them is a set\n union over content-derived identifiers, so it needs no clock agreement,\n no server and no conflict resolution. Merging is commutative and\n idempotent: order does not matter and doing it twice changes nothing.\n \"\"\"\n merged: dict[str, AssetEvent] = {}\n for stream in streams:\n for raw in stream or []:\n event = _coerce_event(raw)\n if event is None:\n continue\n event = event.identified_for(asset_id)\n existing = merged.get(event.event_id)\n if existing is None:\n merged[event.event_id] = event\n elif not existing.photo and event.photo:\n # the only asymmetry: a phone that has the photograph wins,\n # because the alternative is losing it\n merged[event.event_id] = event\n return sorted(merged.values(),\n key=lambda e: (e.when or \"9999\", e.kind, e.event_id))\n\n\n# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n# The asset\n# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\n@dataclass\nclass Asset:\n \"\"\"A borehole, as the people who maintain it see it.\"\"\"\n\n asset_id: str\n community: str = \"\"\n district: str = \"\"\n chiefdom: str = \"\"\n easting: float | None = None\n northing: float | None = None\n utm_zone: int | None = None\n total_depth_m: float | None = None\n safe_yield_m3_per_h: float | None = None\n pump_type: str = \"\"\n installed_by: str = \"\"\n events: list[AssetEvent] = field(default_factory=list)\n\n @property\n def latlon(self) -> tuple[float, float] | None:\n if self.easting is None or self.northing is None:\n return None\n zone = self.utm_zone or infer_zone_for_sierra_leone(float(self.easting))\n try:\n return utm_to_geographic(float(self.easting), float(self.northing),\n int(zone))\n except Exception: # noqa: BLE001 - a bad coordinate simply has no fix\n return None\n\n @property\n def label(self) -> str:\n place = self.community or \"(unnamed site)\"\n return f\"{place} ({self.district})\" if self.district else place\n\n def with_events(self, *streams) -> \"Asset\":\n \"\"\"A copy carrying the merged union of this asset's events and more.\"\"\"\n return Asset(**{**self.__dict__,\n \"events\": merge_events(self.asset_id, self.events,\n *streams)})\n\n def as_dict(self) -> dict:\n payload = {k: v for k, v in self.__dict__.items() if k != \"events\"}\n payload[\"events\"] = [e.identified_for(self.asset_id).as_dict()\n for e in self.events]\n return payload\n\n\ndef asset_from_dict(payload: dict) -> Asset | None:\n \"\"\"Rebuild an asset from a saved project file, or ``None`` if it is not one.\"\"\"\n if not isinstance(payload, dict):\n return None\n asset_id = parse_asset_id(payload.get(\"asset_id\"))\n if not asset_id:\n return None\n known = {f for f in Asset.__dataclass_fields__ if f != \"events\"}\n fields = {k: v for k, v in payload.items() if k in known}\n fields[\"asset_id\"] = asset_id\n asset = Asset(**fields)\n asset.events = merge_events(asset_id, payload.get(\"events\") or [])\n return asset\n\n\ndef asset_from_project(state: dict) -> Asset | None:\n \"\"\"Draft an asset from an assembled project, or ``None`` without a position.\n\n Nothing is invented: the commissioning event is not written here, because\n a borehole is commissioned by somebody deciding it is, on a day, and that\n decision is a record with a name on it rather than a side effect of\n opening a page.\n \"\"\"\n site = _project_site(state)\n if site is None:\n return None\n try:\n asset_id = mint_asset_id(site)\n except ValueError:\n return None\n log = state.get(\"drilling_log\")\n analysis = state.get(\"pump_analysis\")\n depth = getattr(log, \"total_depth_m\", None) if log is not None else None\n recommendation = getattr(analysis, \"yield_recommendation\", None)\n return Asset(\n asset_id=asset_id,\n community=getattr(site, \"community\", \"\") or \"\",\n district=getattr(site, \"district\", \"\") or \"\",\n chiefdom=getattr(site, \"chiefdom\", \"\") or \"\",\n easting=getattr(site, \"easting\", None),\n northing=getattr(site, \"northing\", None),\n utm_zone=getattr(site, \"utm_zone\", None),\n total_depth_m=depth,\n safe_yield_m3_per_h=getattr(recommendation, \"safe_yield_m3_per_h\", None),\n installed_by=getattr(site, \"contractor\", \"\") or \"\",\n )\n\n\ndef _project_site(state: dict):\n \"\"\"The site metadata, merged across the sheets that carry any of it.\"\"\"\n candidates = [state.get(\"site\")]\n log = state.get(\"drilling_log\")\n if log is not None:\n candidates.append(getattr(log, \"site\", None))\n analysis = state.get(\"pump_analysis\")\n if analysis is not None:\n candidates.append(getattr(getattr(analysis, \"test\", None), \"site\", None))\n assessment = state.get(\"wq_assessment\")\n if assessment is not None:\n candidates.append(getattr(getattr(assessment, \"sample\", None), \"site\",\n None))\n merged = None\n for site in candidates:\n if site is None:\n continue\n if merged is None:\n merged = site\n continue\n try:\n merged = merged.merged_with(site)\n except AttributeError: # noqa: PERF203 - a plain object is fine as-is\n continue\n if merged is None:\n return None\n return merged if getattr(merged, \"easting\", None) is not None else None\n\n\n# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n# What is true today\n# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\n@dataclass(frozen=True)\nclass Schedule:\n \"\"\"How often a working point should be visited.\n\n These are defaults, not a standard. Surveillance intervals for rural\n point sources are set by the programme and by the district, and vary\n with how many people drink from the point and what the last result said;\n a six-monthly sanitary inspection and an annual water sample is a common\n baseline to start from and to argue with. Change them here and every\n due-date in the registry moves with them.\n \"\"\"\n\n inspection_months: int = 6\n water_sample_months: int = 12\n #: How long past due before an item stops being \"due\" and starts being\n #: \"overdue\". A visit is a journey, not a diary entry.\n grace_days: int = 30\n\n\n@dataclass(frozen=True)\nclass DueItem:\n key: str\n title: str\n due_on: date | None\n state: str # \"due\" | \"overdue\" | \"unknown\"\n detail: str\n\n def as_dict(self) -> dict:\n return {\"key\": self.key, \"title\": self.title, \"state\": self.state,\n \"due_on\": self.due_on.isoformat() if self.due_on else None,\n \"detail\": self.detail}\n\n\n@dataclass(frozen=True)\nclass AssetState:\n \"\"\"What the event stream says about the borehole now.\"\"\"\n\n function: str\n since: date | None\n detail: str\n last_inspection: date | None\n last_sample: date | None\n commissioned: date | None\n days_out_of_service: int | None\n due: tuple[DueItem, ...]\n undated_events: int\n\n @property\n def label(self) -> str:\n return FUNCTION_LABELS.get(self.function, \"Not known\")\n\n @property\n def is_working(self) -> bool:\n \"\"\"True only when something says so. ``unknown`` is not a yes.\"\"\"\n return self.function == \"functional\"\n\n @property\n def overdue(self) -> tuple[DueItem, ...]:\n return tuple(item for item in self.due if item.state == \"overdue\")\n\n def as_dict(self) -> dict:\n return {\n \"function\": self.function, \"label\": self.label,\n \"since\": self.since.isoformat() if self.since else None,\n \"detail\": self.detail,\n \"last_inspection\": self.last_inspection.isoformat()\n if self.last_inspection else None,\n \"last_sample\": self.last_sample.isoformat()\n if self.last_sample else None,\n \"commissioned\": self.commissioned.isoformat()\n if self.commissioned else None,\n \"days_out_of_service\": self.days_out_of_service,\n \"due\": [item.as_dict() for item in self.due],\n \"undated_events\": self.undated_events,\n }\n\n\ndef _add_months(start: date, months: int) -> date:\n month = start.month - 1 + months\n year = start.year + month // 12\n month = month % 12 + 1\n # clamp rather than roll over: six months from 31 August is 28 February,\n # not 3 March, and a due date that drifts forward is one that gets missed\n day = min(start.day, [31, 29 if year % 4 == 0 and (year % 100 or not\n year % 400) else 28,\n 31, 30, 31, 30, 31, 31, 30, 31, 30, 31][month - 1])\n return date(year, month, day)\n\n\ndef asset_state(asset: Asset, today: date | None = None,\n schedule: Schedule | None = None) -> AssetState:\n \"\"\"Reduce the event stream to the borehole's condition on ``today``.\"\"\"\n today = today or date.today()\n schedule = schedule or Schedule()\n events = merge_events(asset.asset_id, asset.events)\n dated = [(e.date, e) for e in events if e.date is not None]\n dated.sort(key=lambda pair: (pair[0], pair[1].kind, pair[1].event_id))\n undated = sum(1 for e in events if e.date is None)\n\n function, since, detail = \"unknown\", None, (\n \"Nothing has been recorded against this borehole, so whether it is \"\n \"working is not known.\")\n commissioned = last_inspection = last_sample = None\n for when, event in dated:\n if when > today:\n continue # a record dated in the future settles nothing yet\n establishes = EVENT_KINDS.get(event.kind, (\"\", None, False))[1]\n if establishes:\n function, since = establishes, when\n detail = f\"{event.label} recorded on {when.isoformat()}\"\n if event.by:\n detail += f\" by {event.by}\"\n if event.kind == \"commissioned\" and commissioned is None:\n commissioned = when\n if event.kind == \"inspection\":\n last_inspection = when\n if event.kind == \"water_sample\":\n last_sample = when\n\n out_for = ((today - since).days\n if function == \"non_functional\" and since else None)\n if undated and function == \"unknown\":\n detail = (f\"{undated} record(s) carry a date nobody can read, so \"\n \"nothing can be established from them.\")\n\n due: list[DueItem] = []\n if function != \"decommissioned\":\n due.append(_due_item(\n \"inspection\", \"Sanitary inspection\", last_inspection, commissioned,\n schedule.inspection_months, schedule.grace_days, today,\n \"A sanitary inspection is what catches a cracked apron or a \"\n \"latrine dug uphill before the water shows it.\"))\n due.append(_due_item(\n \"water_sample\", \"Water quality sample\", last_sample, commissioned,\n schedule.water_sample_months, schedule.grace_days, today,\n \"Water that was safe at handover is not evidence that it is safe \"\n \"now: the aquifer, the headworks and the catchment all change.\"))\n return AssetState(\n function=function, since=since, detail=detail,\n last_inspection=last_inspection, last_sample=last_sample,\n commissioned=commissioned, days_out_of_service=out_for,\n due=tuple(item for item in due if item is not None),\n undated_events=undated,\n )\n\n\ndef _due_item(key: str, title: str, last: date | None, commissioned: date | None,\n months: int, grace_days: int, today: date, why: str) -> DueItem:\n anchor = last or commissioned\n if anchor is None:\n return DueItem(key, title, None, \"unknown\",\n f\"No {title.lower()} has been recorded, and there is no \"\n f\"commissioning date to count from. {why}\")\n due_on = _add_months(anchor, months)\n if today > due_on + timedelta(days=grace_days):\n overdue_by = (today - due_on).days\n never = \"\" if last else \"has never been done; it \"\n return DueItem(key, title, due_on, \"overdue\",\n f\"{title} {never}has been due since \"\n f\"{due_on.isoformat()}, {overdue_by} days ago. {why}\")\n if today > due_on:\n return DueItem(key, title, due_on, \"due\",\n f\"{title} fell due on {due_on.isoformat()}.\")\n return DueItem(key, title, due_on, \"scheduled\",\n f\"Next {title.lower()} due {due_on.isoformat()}.\")\n\n\n# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n# What goes on the borehole itself\n# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\ndef qr_payload(asset: Asset) -> str:\n \"\"\"The text the QR code carries.\n\n Plain text rather than a link. A link is only useful where there is a\n network, and the whole reason this symbol is on the headworks is that\n there is not one - a technician who scans it should see the identifier,\n the place and the position on the screen immediately, with nothing to\n load and nothing to install.\n \"\"\"\n lines = [f\"BOREHOLE {asset.asset_id}\", asset.label]\n latlon = asset.latlon\n if latlon is not None:\n lat, lon = latlon\n lines.append(f\"{abs(lat):.5f} {'N' if lat >= 0 else 'S'}, \"\n f\"{abs(lon):.5f} {'E' if lon >= 0 else 'W'}\")\n facts = []\n if asset.total_depth_m:\n facts.append(f\"{float(asset.total_depth_m):.1f} m deep\")\n if asset.safe_yield_m3_per_h:\n facts.append(f\"{float(asset.safe_yield_m3_per_h):.2f} m3/h\")\n if asset.pump_type:\n facts.append(asset.pump_type)\n if facts:\n lines.append(\", \".join(facts))\n return \"\\n\".join(lines)\n\n\ndef placard_lines(asset: Asset, state: AssetState | None = None) -> list[tuple[str, str]]:\n \"\"\"Field-value rows for the plate that gets fixed to the headworks.\"\"\"\n rows = [(\"Identifier\", asset.asset_id), (\"Community\", asset.community or \"-\")]\n if asset.district:\n rows.append((\"District\", asset.district))\n latlon = asset.latlon\n if latlon is not None:\n rows.append((\"Position\", f\"{latlon[0]:.5f} N, {abs(latlon[1]):.5f} W\"))\n if asset.total_depth_m:\n rows.append((\"Depth\", f\"{float(asset.total_depth_m):.1f} m\"))\n if asset.safe_yield_m3_per_h:\n rows.append((\"Safe yield\", f\"{float(asset.safe_yield_m3_per_h):.2f} m3/h\"))\n if asset.pump_type:\n rows.append((\"Pump\", asset.pump_type))\n if asset.installed_by:\n rows.append((\"Installed by\", asset.installed_by))\n if state is not None:\n if state.commissioned:\n rows.append((\"Commissioned\", state.commissioned.isoformat()))\n rows.append((\"Status\", state.label))\n return rows\n\n\n# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n# Many of them\n# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\ndef registry_rows(assets, today: date | None = None,\n schedule: Schedule | None = None) -> list[dict]:\n \"\"\"One formatted row per asset, for the registry table.\"\"\"\n today = today or date.today()\n rows = []\n for asset in assets:\n state = asset_state(asset, today, schedule)\n overdue = state.overdue\n rows.append({\n \"Identifier\": asset.asset_id,\n \"Community\": asset.community or \"(unnamed)\",\n \"District\": asset.district or \"\",\n \"Status\": state.label,\n \"Since\": state.since.isoformat() if state.since else \"\",\n \"Last inspected\": state.last_inspection.isoformat()\n if state.last_inspection else \"\",\n \"Last sampled\": state.last_sample.isoformat()\n if state.last_sample else \"\",\n \"Overdue\": \", \".join(item.title for item in overdue),\n \"Events\": len(asset.events),\n })\n return rows\n\n\ndef registry_stats(assets, today: date | None = None,\n schedule: Schedule | None = None) -> dict:\n \"\"\"Headline counts.\n\n ``n_unknown`` is reported beside the working and broken counts and never\n folded into either. A register where most points are unknown looks very\n like one where most points are working, unless the number is on the\n page next to them.\n \"\"\"\n today = today or date.today()\n assets = list(assets)\n counts = {key: 0 for key in FUNCTION_LABELS}\n overdue_by_key: dict[str, int] = {}\n out_days = []\n for asset in assets:\n state = asset_state(asset, today, schedule)\n counts[state.function] = counts.get(state.function, 0) + 1\n if state.days_out_of_service is not None:\n out_days.append(state.days_out_of_service)\n for item in state.overdue:\n overdue_by_key[item.key] = overdue_by_key.get(item.key, 0) + 1\n known = counts[\"functional\"] + counts[\"non_functional\"]\n return {\n \"n_assets\": len(assets),\n \"n_functional\": counts[\"functional\"],\n \"n_non_functional\": counts[\"non_functional\"],\n \"n_decommissioned\": counts[\"decommissioned\"],\n \"n_unknown\": counts[\"unknown\"],\n # over the points whose condition is actually known, and None when\n # none of them are - a functionality rate computed over silence is\n # the number that makes these registers untrustworthy\n \"functionality_rate\": (counts[\"functional\"] / known * 100.0)\n if known else None,\n \"n_overdue_inspection\": overdue_by_key.get(\"inspection\", 0),\n \"n_overdue_sample\": overdue_by_key.get(\"water_sample\", 0),\n \"mean_days_out_of_service\": (sum(out_days) / len(out_days))\n if out_days else None,\n }\n"}, "groundwater/reporting/__init__.py": {"t": "text", "d": "\"\"\"Templated .docx report generation.\"\"\"\n\nfrom .docx_utils import ReportBuilder\nfrom .geophysical import build_geophysical_report\n\n__all__ = [\"ReportBuilder\", \"build_geophysical_report\"]\n\n\ndef __getattr__(name):\n # Phase 2 report builders are imported lazily so Phase 1 users are\n # not blocked by missing optional pieces during development.\n if name == \"build_completion_report\":\n from .completion import build_completion_report\n\n return build_completion_report\n if name == \"build_pumping_report\":\n from .pumping import build_pumping_report\n\n return build_pumping_report\n if name == \"build_quality_report\":\n from .quality import build_quality_report\n\n return build_quality_report\n if name == \"build_handover_report\":\n from .handover import build_handover_report\n\n return build_handover_report\n raise AttributeError(name)\n"}, "groundwater/reporting/citations.py": {"t": "text", "d": "\"\"\"Reference citations and a glossary shared by the report builders.\n\nThe reports name methods, standards and datasets throughout (WHO\nguidelines, RWSN cost guidance, Theis, Cooper-Jacob, the bundled map\nsources). This module holds the full citations so a References section can\nclose each report, and a glossary of the abbreviations the reports use, so\nthey read as consultant-grade documents rather than naming sources that are\nnever fully cited.\n\"\"\"\n\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\n# full bibliography entries, keyed by a short id\nCITATIONS: dict[str, str] = {\n \"who\": (\n \"World Health Organization (2022). Guidelines for Drinking-water \"\n \"Quality, 4th edition incorporating the first and second addenda. \"\n \"Geneva: World Health Organization.\"\n ),\n \"slsb\": (\n \"Sierra Leone Standards Bureau. Sierra Leone Standard for drinking \"\n \"water quality (SLS). Freetown: SLSB.\"\n ),\n \"rwsn_cost\": (\n \"Rural Water Supply Network (2010). Code of Practice for Cost \"\n \"Effective Boreholes. St Gallen: RWSN.\"\n ),\n \"rwsn_drilling\": (\n \"Rural Water Supply Network (2015). Professional Water Well Drilling: \"\n \"A UNICEF Guidance Note. St Gallen: RWSN / UNICEF.\"\n ),\n \"theis\": (\n \"Theis, C.V. (1935). The relation between the lowering of the \"\n \"piezometric surface and the rate and duration of discharge of a well \"\n \"using groundwater storage. Transactions of the American Geophysical \"\n \"Union, 16, 519-524.\"\n ),\n \"cooper_jacob\": (\n \"Cooper, H.H. and Jacob, C.E. (1946). A generalized graphical method \"\n \"for evaluating formation constants and summarizing well-field \"\n \"history. Transactions of the American Geophysical Union, 27, 526-534.\"\n ),\n \"hantush\": (\n \"Hantush, M.S. (1964). Hydraulics of wells. In V.T. Chow (ed.), \"\n \"Advances in Hydroscience, 1, 281-442.\"\n ),\n \"niwas_singhal\": (\n \"Niwas, S. and Singhal, D.C. (1981). Estimation of aquifer \"\n \"transmissivity from Dar-Zarrouk parameters in porous media. Journal \"\n \"of Hydrology, 50, 393-399.\"\n ),\n \"langelier\": (\n \"Langelier, W.F. (1936). The analytical control of anti-corrosion \"\n \"water treatment. Journal of the American Water Works Association, 28, \"\n \"1500-1521.\"\n ),\n \"geoboundaries\": (\n \"Runfola, D. et al. (2020). geoBoundaries: A global database of \"\n \"political administrative boundaries. PLoS ONE, 15(4). Licensed CC BY \"\n \"4.0.\"\n ),\n \"bgs_atlas\": (\n \"MacDonald, A.M. et al. British Geological Survey, Africa Groundwater \"\n \"Atlas: Hydrogeology of Sierra Leone (OR/21/063). Licensed CC BY-SA \"\n \"4.0.\"\n ),\n \"usgs_geology\": (\n \"United States Geological Survey (1997). Geologic Map of Africa, \"\n \"Open-File Report 97-470A. Public domain, 1:5,000,000.\"\n ),\n \"salwaco_geology\": (\n \"Ministry of Water Resources and SALWACO (2017). Geology of Sierra \"\n \"Leone. Freetown.\"\n ),\n}\n\n# references relevant to each report type, in a sensible reading order\n_REFERENCES_FOR = {\n \"geophysical\": [\n \"salwaco_geology\", \"usgs_geology\", \"bgs_atlas\", \"geoboundaries\",\n \"niwas_singhal\", \"rwsn_drilling\",\n ],\n \"pumping\": [\"theis\", \"cooper_jacob\", \"hantush\", \"rwsn_drilling\"],\n \"quality\": [\"who\", \"slsb\", \"langelier\"],\n \"completion\": [\"rwsn_drilling\", \"rwsn_cost\", \"who\", \"slsb\"],\n \"handover\": [\"rwsn_drilling\", \"who\", \"slsb\"],\n \"cost\": [\"rwsn_cost\", \"rwsn_drilling\"],\n \"supervision\": [\"rwsn_drilling\", \"rwsn_cost\"],\n}\n\n\ndef references_for(kind: str) -> list[str]:\n \"\"\"Full bibliography entries for a report type.\"\"\"\n return [CITATIONS[key] for key in _REFERENCES_FOR.get(kind, []) if key in CITATIONS]\n\n\n# glossary of abbreviations and terms used across the reports\nGLOSSARY: list[tuple[str, str]] = [\n (\"VES\", \"Vertical electrical sounding, a resistivity depth survey\"),\n (\"AB/2\", \"Half the current-electrode spacing in a Schlumberger array\"),\n (\"ohm-m\", \"Ohm-metre, the unit of electrical resistivity\"),\n (\"ERR\", \"Root-mean-square misfit of the fitted layered model (percent)\"),\n (\"S (Dar-Zarrouk)\", \"Longitudinal conductance, sum of thickness/resistivity (siemens)\"),\n (\"T (Dar-Zarrouk)\", \"Transverse resistance, sum of thickness x resistivity (ohm m2)\"),\n (\"SWL\", \"Static water level, the rest water level before pumping\"),\n (\"DWL\", \"Dynamic water level, the water level during pumping\"),\n (\"T (transmissivity)\", \"Aquifer transmissivity (m2/day)\"),\n (\"S (storativity)\", \"Aquifer storage coefficient (dimensionless)\"),\n (\"m3/h\", \"Cubic metres per hour, a discharge or yield rate\"),\n (\"LSI / RSI\", \"Langelier and Ryznar indices of water corrosivity and scaling\"),\n (\"WQI\", \"Water Quality Index, an aggregate 0-based quality score\"),\n (\"HI\", \"Health Hazard Index, the sum of chronic hazard quotients\"),\n (\"uPVC\", \"Unplasticised polyvinyl chloride, the casing and screen material\"),\n (\"GPS / UTM\", \"Satellite positioning and the Universal Transverse Mercator grid\"),\n (\"WASH\", \"Water, sanitation and hygiene\"),\n (\"RWSN\", \"Rural Water Supply Network\"),\n (\"SALWACO\", \"Sierra Leone Water Company\"),\n (\"WHO\", \"World Health Organization\"),\n (\"SLSB\", \"Sierra Leone Standards Bureau\"),\n]\n"}, "groundwater/reporting/completion.py": {"t": "text", "d": "\"\"\"Borehole completion report generator.\n\nFollows the structure of the contractor completion report example:\nintroduction, methodology, drilling works, borehole log data with the\ndrilling record table, borehole construction and design drawing,\ndevelopment record, pumping test summary, borehole characteristics and\ninstallation block, recommendations and conclusions, and the preparer\nsignature block.\n\"\"\"\n\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom typing import Any\n\nfrom dataclasses import dataclass, field\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nfrom ..config import Config\nfrom ..design.designer import BoreholeDesign\nfrom ..design.drawing import draw_borehole_design\nfrom ..hydraulics.analysis import PumpingTestAnalysis\nfrom ..hydraulics.plots import plot_test_overview\nfrom ..models import DrillingLog\nfrom ..quality.assess import (\n SUITABILITY_PHRASE,\n SUITABILITY_SENTENCE,\n WaterQualityAssessment,\n)\nfrom ..utils import fmt_num, safe_slug\nfrom .citations import GLOSSARY, references_for\nfrom .docx_utils import ReportBuilder\n\n\n@dataclass\nclass CompletionReportInputs:\n log: DrillingLog\n design: BoreholeDesign | None = None\n pumping: PumpingTestAnalysis | None = None\n quality: WaterQualityAssessment | None = None\n figures_dir: Path = Path(\".\")\n development_record: list[tuple[str, str, str, str]] = field(default_factory=list)\n # rows of (from time, to time, estimated yield, observation)\n development_note: str = \"\"\n pump_type: str = \"\"\n preparer_name: str = \"\"\n preparer_role: str = \"Technical Manager\"\n preparer_phone: str = \"\"\n #: The certification gate for this report, from\n #: :func:`groundwater.readiness.assess_readiness`. When it is not\n #: certifiable the cover says so; when it is absent nothing is\n #: stamped, so an existing caller is unaffected.\n readiness: Any = None\n\n\ndef _breached_limit(r) -> str:\n \"\"\"The limit the parameter actually breached, matching its status.\n\n Avoids the fixed who_health-first precedence that could display a limit the\n parameter did not exceed (e.g. a WHO health value that was not breached)\n while the remark names the national or aesthetic limit that was.\n \"\"\"\n if r.status == \"exceeds_national\":\n return r.sl_standard or r.who_health or r.who_aesthetic\n if r.status == \"exceeds_aesthetic\":\n return r.who_aesthetic or r.sl_standard or r.who_health\n # exceeds_health (or anything else): prefer the health value, then fall\n # back so microbiological rows whose limit sits in another column still show\n return r.who_health or r.sl_standard or r.who_aesthetic\n\n\ndef _executive_summary(inputs: CompletionReportInputs) -> tuple[list[str], list[str]]:\n \"\"\"Compose the completion executive summary from the drilling and test data.\"\"\"\n log = inputs.log\n community = log.site.community or \"the site\"\n analysis = inputs.pumping\n yr = analysis.yield_recommendation if analysis else None\n quality = inputs.quality\n status = (log.status or \"\").strip()\n\n bits = [\n \"This report documents the drilling, construction and testing of the \"\n f\"borehole at {community}.\"\n ]\n if log.total_depth_m:\n s = f\"The borehole was drilled to {fmt_num(log.total_depth_m)} m\"\n if log.drilling_method:\n s += f\" by {log.drilling_method}\"\n if status:\n s += f\" and is recorded as {status.lower()}\"\n bits.append(s + \".\")\n if yr is not None and yr.safe_yield_m3_per_h:\n bits.append(\n f\"The recommended safe yield is {fmt_num(yr.safe_yield_m3_per_h)} m3/h \"\n f\"at a pump setting of {fmt_num(yr.pump_installation_depth_m)} m.\"\n )\n elif analysis is not None and not analysis.test.has_discharge:\n bits.append(\n \"The pumping test discharge is pending, so the yield figures are not \"\n \"yet final.\"\n )\n if quality is not None:\n # Chosen on the full verdict state, not the health exceedances alone:\n # a national breach or an unevaluable panel used to read as suitable.\n bits.append(SUITABILITY_SENTENCE[quality.verdict_state])\n\n key: list[str] = []\n if log.total_depth_m:\n key.append(\n f\"Borehole depth: {fmt_num(log.total_depth_m)} m\"\n + (f\", {status}.\" if status else \".\")\n )\n if yr is not None and yr.safe_yield_m3_per_h:\n key.append(f\"Safe yield: {fmt_num(yr.safe_yield_m3_per_h)} m3/h.\")\n if quality is not None:\n key.append(\"Water safety: \" + SUITABILITY_PHRASE[quality.verdict_state])\n return [\" \".join(bits)], key\n\n\ndef build_completion_report(\n inputs: CompletionReportInputs,\n out_path: str | Path,\n config: Config | None = None,\n) -> Path:\n config = config or Config()\n log = inputs.log\n site = log.site\n figures = Path(inputs.figures_dir)\n figures.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)\n # Qualify figure filenames with the borehole so several reports written\n # into one figures directory cannot silently reuse each other's PNGs (the\n # generation is guarded by an existence check).\n slug = safe_slug(log.borehole_ref or site.community, \"bh\")\n\n rb = ReportBuilder(\n config.style, title=f\"Borehole Completion Report - {site.community}\"\n )\n rb.cover(\n title_lines=[\"BOREHOLE DRILLING AND\", \"PUMP TEST REPORT\"],\n subtitle_lines=[f\"for {site.community}\"],\n details=[\n (\"Submitted to\", site.client),\n (\"Contractor\", site.contractor or \"\"),\n (\"Borehole Ref. No.\", log.borehole_ref or \"\"),\n (\"Completion date\", log.completion_date or \"\"),\n (\"Status\", log.status or \"\"),\n ],\n )\n rb.provisional_stamp(inputs.readiness)\n rb.table_of_contents()\n\n # ---- executive summary ---------------------------------------------------\n exec_paras, exec_key = _executive_summary(inputs)\n rb.executive_summary(exec_paras, exec_key)\n\n # ---- introduction --------------------------------------------------------\n rb.heading(\"1. Introduction\", 1)\n rb.paragraph(\n \"Groundwater can be abstracted from the ground in different ways, and \"\n \"the choice of abstraction method depends on the resources available \"\n \"and the local conditions. Borehole drilling was the recommended \"\n f\"abstraction method for this project at {site.community}, and the \"\n \"work was executed as per the specifications. Details of the \"\n \"activities are presented in this report.\",\n align=\"justify\",\n )\n\n # ---- methodology -----------------------------------------------------------\n rb.heading(\"2. Methodology\", 1)\n rb.paragraph(\n \"The methodology adopted included reconnaissance, observation of the \"\n \"geological and hydrogeological conditions, assessment of existing \"\n \"boreholes and hand dug wells, drilling, construction, development \"\n \"and test pumping of the borehole.\",\n align=\"justify\",\n )\n\n # ---- drilling ---------------------------------------------------------------\n rb.heading(\"3. Drilling\", 1)\n rb.paragraph(\"The drilling work included the following:\")\n rb.bullets(\n [\n \"Mobilisation of the drill rig and all necessary equipment.\",\n \"Drilling through all formations for completion of the borehole\"\n + (f\" using the {log.drilling_method} method.\" if log.drilling_method else \".\"),\n \"Supply and installation of casings (plain and screen).\",\n \"Gravel packing of the annulus.\",\n \"Development of the borehole by surging with compressed air and airlifting.\",\n \"Demobilisation.\",\n ]\n )\n rb.header_block_table(\n [\n (\"Contractor\", site.contractor or \"\"), (\"Client\", site.client),\n (\"Location\", site.community), (\"Depth of borehole\", fmt_num(log.total_depth_m) + \" m\"),\n (\"Start date\", log.start_date), (\"Completion date\", log.completion_date),\n (\"Drilling method\", log.drilling_method), (\"BH status\", log.status),\n ]\n )\n\n # ---- borehole log -------------------------------------------------------------\n rb.heading(\"4. Borehole Log Data\", 1)\n rows = []\n for iv in log.intervals:\n rows.append(\n [\n f\"{iv.top_m:g}-{iv.bottom_m:g}\",\n fmt_num(iv.thickness_m),\n iv.from_time,\n iv.to_time,\n fmt_num(iv.penetration_rate_m_per_min) if iv.penetration_rate_m_per_min else \"\",\n iv.description,\n f'{iv.bit_diameter_in:g}\"' if iv.bit_diameter_in else \"\",\n ]\n )\n rb.table(\n rows,\n header=[\"Depth (m)\", \"Interval (m)\", \"From\", \"To\",\n \"Penetration rate (m/min)\", \"Sample description\", \"Diameter\"],\n caption=\"Drilling record and formation log.\",\n font_size_pt=8.5,\n )\n strikes = log.water_strikes_m\n if strikes:\n for i, strike in enumerate(strikes, start=1):\n label = [\"First\", \"Second\", \"Third\", \"Fourth\"][i - 1] if i <= 4 else f\"{i}th\"\n rb.paragraph(f\"{label} water strike: {strike:g} m\", bold=True)\n if log.grouting_depth_m:\n rb.paragraph(f\"Grouting: {log.grouting_depth_m:g} m\", bold=True)\n\n # ---- construction / design ---------------------------------------------------\n if inputs.design is not None:\n rb.heading(\"5. Borehole Construction\", 1)\n design_fig = figures / f\"borehole_design_{slug}.png\"\n if not design_fig.exists():\n draw_borehole_design(\n inputs.design, log, path=design_fig, style=config.style,\n title=f\"Borehole design - {site.community} ({log.borehole_ref})\",\n header_pairs=[\n (\"Client\", site.client), (\"Contractor\", site.contractor or \"\"),\n (\"Method\", log.drilling_method), (\"Status\", log.status),\n ],\n )\n rb.table(\n [[k, v] for k, v in inputs.design.summary_rows()],\n header=[\"Item\", \"Detail\"],\n caption=\"Construction summary.\",\n )\n rb.figure(design_fig, \"As-built borehole design with lithology and construction columns.\", width_cm=13.5)\n if inputs.design.design_basis:\n rb.paragraph(\"Design basis:\", bold=True)\n rb.bullets(inputs.design.design_basis)\n\n # ---- development ---------------------------------------------------------------\n section = 6 if inputs.design is not None else 5\n if inputs.development_record or inputs.development_note:\n rb.heading(f\"{section}. Borehole Development Record\", 1)\n if inputs.development_note:\n rb.paragraph(inputs.development_note)\n if inputs.development_record:\n rb.table(\n [list(r) for r in inputs.development_record],\n header=[\"From\", \"To\", \"Estimated yield (m3/h)\", \"Observation\"],\n caption=\"Borehole development by air lifting.\",\n )\n section += 1\n\n # ---- pumping test ---------------------------------------------------------------\n if inputs.pumping is not None:\n analysis = inputs.pumping\n test = analysis.test\n rb.heading(f\"{section}. Pumping Test\", 1)\n overview = figures / f\"test_overview_{slug}.png\"\n if not overview.exists():\n plot_test_overview(test, path=overview, style=config.style)\n rb.figure(overview, \"Constant discharge test and recovery record.\")\n # the maximum drawdown below is measured at the end of the last step,\n # so the rate quoted beside it has to be that step's, not step 1's\n q = test.steps[-1].discharge_m3_per_h if test.steps else None\n q_label = \"Discharge (final step)\" if len(test.steps) > 1 else \"Discharge\"\n rows = [\n [\"Test type\", test.test_type],\n [\"Duration\", fmt_num(test.pumping_duration_min) + \" min\" if test.pumping_duration_min else \"\"],\n [q_label, fmt_num(q) + \" m3/h\" if q else \"pending\"],\n [\"Static water level\", fmt_num(test.static_water_level_m) + \" m\"],\n [\"Maximum drawdown\", fmt_num(analysis.max_drawdown_m) + \" m\" if analysis.max_drawdown_m else \"\"],\n ]\n if analysis.transmissivity_m2_per_day:\n rows.append([\"Transmissivity\", fmt_num(analysis.transmissivity_m2_per_day) + \" m2/day\"])\n yr = analysis.yield_recommendation\n if yr and yr.specific_capacity_m3hr_per_m:\n rows.append([\"Specific capacity\", fmt_num(yr.specific_capacity_m3hr_per_m) + \" m3/h per m\"])\n rb.table(rows, header=[\"Item\", \"Value\"], caption=\"Pumping test summary.\")\n section += 1\n\n # ---- characteristics and installation ------------------------------------------\n rb.heading(f\"{section}. Borehole Characteristics and Installation\", 1)\n swl = inputs.pumping.test.static_water_level_m if inputs.pumping else None\n dwl = None\n if inputs.pumping and inputs.pumping.test.steps and swl is not None:\n dwl = float(inputs.pumping.test.steps[-1].water_level_m[-1])\n q = None\n if inputs.pumping and inputs.pumping.test.steps:\n # the same step the dynamic level above came from. Taking the rate\n # from the first step and the level from the last paired step 1's\n # 2.5 m3/h with step 3's 59 m of drawdown - read by the client as the\n # borehole's yield against its drawdown.\n q = inputs.pumping.test.steps[-1].discharge_m3_per_h\n yr = inputs.pumping.yield_recommendation if inputs.pumping else None\n pairs = [\n (\"Borehole depth\", fmt_num(log.total_depth_m) + \" m\"),\n (\"Borehole diameter\", f'{inputs.design.borehole_diameter_in:g}\"' if inputs.design else \"\"),\n (\"Static water level\", fmt_num(swl) + \" m\" if swl is not None else \"\"),\n (\"Dynamic water level\", fmt_num(dwl) + \" m\" if dwl is not None else \"\"),\n (\"Drawdown\", fmt_num(dwl - swl) + \" m\" if (dwl is not None and swl is not None) else \"\"),\n (\"Flow rate\", fmt_num(q * 1000) + \" L/h\" if q else \"pending\"),\n (\"Pump type\", inputs.pump_type),\n (\"Installation depth\", fmt_num(yr.pump_installation_depth_m) + \" m\" if yr and yr.pump_installation_depth_m else\n (fmt_num(inputs.pumping.test.pump_setting_m) + \" m\" if inputs.pumping and inputs.pumping.test.pump_setting_m else \"\")),\n ]\n rb.header_block_table(pairs)\n section += 1\n\n # ---- water quality (optional) ---------------------------------------------------\n if inputs.quality is not None:\n rb.heading(f\"{section}. Water Quality Summary\", 1)\n rb.paragraph(inputs.quality.verdict, align=\"justify\")\n # every exceedance, national ones included: a national breach is a\n # compliance failure and must appear in the table, not be dropped\n exceed = inputs.quality.all_exceedances\n if exceed:\n rb.table(\n [[r.parameter, fmt_num(r.value), r.unit, _breached_limit(r), r.remark]\n for r in exceed],\n header=[\"Parameter\", \"Value\", \"Unit\", \"Limit\", \"Remark\"],\n caption=\"Parameters above guideline or standard limits.\",\n )\n section += 1\n\n # ---- recommendations ----------------------------------------------------------\n rb.heading(f\"{section}. Recommendations and Conclusions\", 1)\n bullets = []\n if (log.status or \"\").lower().startswith(\"success\") or (\n inputs.pumping and inputs.pumping.yield_recommendation\n and inputs.pumping.yield_recommendation.safe_yield_m3_per_h\n ):\n bullets.append(\"The borehole is successful and sustainable when operated as recommended.\")\n yr = inputs.pumping.yield_recommendation if inputs.pumping else None\n if yr and yr.safe_yield_m3_per_h:\n bullets.append(\n f\"The recommended abstraction rate is {fmt_num(yr.safe_yield_m3_per_h)} m3/h \"\n f\"(safety factor {yr.safety_factor:g} applied to the long term yield).\"\n )\n if yr.pump_installation_depth_m:\n bullets.append(\n f\"The pump installation depth is {fmt_num(yr.pump_installation_depth_m)} m.\"\n )\n bullets.append(\n \"The pump should rest for at least one hour in every pumping \"\n \"cycle and the pumping water level should be checked routinely.\"\n )\n elif inputs.pumping is not None and not inputs.pumping.test.has_discharge:\n bullets.append(\n \"The pumping test discharge must be supplied so the yield \"\n \"recommendation can be completed; abstraction figures remain pending.\"\n )\n state = inputs.quality.verdict_state if inputs.quality is not None else None\n if state in (\"health_fail\", \"national_fail\"):\n bullets.append(\n \"Water treatment is required before drinking; see the water \"\n \"quality assessment.\"\n )\n elif state == \"indeterminate\":\n bullets.append(\n \"The water quality results do not yet establish that the supply is \"\n \"safe to drink: \"\n + \"; \".join(inputs.quality.uncertainties)\n + \". Resolve these before the borehole is handed over.\"\n )\n else:\n bullets.append(\n \"Physico-chemical and bacteriological testing should be repeated \"\n \"at least once a year.\"\n )\n rb.bullets(bullets)\n\n # ---- references and glossary -----------------------------------------------\n rb.references(references_for(\"completion\"))\n rb.glossary(GLOSSARY)\n\n rb.signature_block(\n name=inputs.preparer_name or site.supervisor,\n role=inputs.preparer_role,\n phone=inputs.preparer_phone,\n organisation=site.contractor or config.style.organisation,\n )\n return rb.save(out_path)\n"}, "groundwater/reporting/context.py": {"t": "text", "d": "\"\"\"Context map figures shared by the report builders.\n\nWhen a site has coordinates, the reports embed the administrative\nlocation map and the local geological and hydrogeological setting\nmaps, generated once into the report's figures directory.\n\"\"\"\n\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nfrom ..config import HouseStyle\nfrom ..mapping import (\n plot_admin_map,\n plot_geological_map,\n plot_hydrogeology_map,\n)\nfrom ..models import SiteMetadata\n\n\ndef context_map_figures(\n site: SiteMetadata | None,\n figures_dir: str | Path,\n style: HouseStyle | None = None,\n local_radius_km: float = 40.0,\n) -> dict[str, Path]:\n \"\"\"Generate the context maps for a site (empty without coordinates).\n\n Returns paths keyed ``admin``, ``geology`` and ``hydrogeology``.\n Existing files are reused so repeated report builds stay\n reproducible and fast.\n \"\"\"\n if site is None or site.latlon is None:\n return {}\n figures = Path(figures_dir)\n figures.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)\n # figure names carry the coordinates, so an existing map for a\n # DIFFERENT site is never reused when the coordinates change\n lat, lon = site.latlon\n token = f\"{lat:.4f}_{abs(lon):.4f}\".replace(\".\", \"p\")\n out: dict[str, Path] = {}\n admin = figures / f\"admin_map_{token}.png\"\n if not admin.exists():\n plot_admin_map(site, path=admin, style=style)\n out[\"admin\"] = admin\n geology = figures / f\"geology_local_map_{token}.png\"\n if not geology.exists():\n plot_geological_map(site, path=geology, style=style,\n radius_km=local_radius_km)\n out[\"geology\"] = geology\n hydro = figures / f\"hydro_local_map_{token}.png\"\n if not hydro.exists():\n plot_hydrogeology_map(site, path=hydro, style=style,\n radius_km=local_radius_km)\n out[\"hydrogeology\"] = hydro\n return out\n"}, "groundwater/reporting/costing.py": {"t": "text", "d": "\"\"\"Borehole cost estimate report generator.\n\nA short client-ready document: the basis of the estimate, the bill of\nquantities, the cost and price roll-up and the assumptions, following\nthe RWSN Cost-Effective Boreholes methodology (cost first, price\nseparately, both breakdowns shown).\n\"\"\"\n\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom dataclasses import dataclass\nfrom pathlib import Path\nfrom typing import Any\n\nfrom ..config import Config\nfrom ..costing.model import CostEstimate\nfrom ..costing.plots import plot_cost_breakdown\nfrom ..models import SiteMetadata\nfrom ..utils import fmt_num\nfrom .docx_utils import ReportBuilder\n\n\n@dataclass\nclass CostReportInputs:\n estimate: CostEstimate\n site: SiteMetadata | None = None\n figures_dir: Path = Path(\".\")\n prepared_by: str = \"\"\n #: :class:`~groundwater.readiness.Readiness` for this report, from\n #: :func:`groundwater.readiness.assess_readiness`. When it is not\n #: certifiable the cover carries a PROVISIONAL stamp listing why.\n readiness: Any = None\n\n\ndef build_cost_report(\n inputs: CostReportInputs,\n out_path: str | Path,\n config: Config | None = None,\n) -> Path:\n config = config or Config()\n estimate = inputs.estimate\n site = inputs.site or SiteMetadata()\n figures = Path(inputs.figures_dir)\n figures.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)\n\n rb = ReportBuilder(\n config.style,\n title=f\"Cost Estimate - {site.community or 'Borehole'}\",\n )\n rb.cover(\n title_lines=[\"BOREHOLE COST ESTIMATE\"],\n subtitle_lines=[\n f\"at {site.community}\" + (f\", {site.district} District\" if site.district else \"\")\n if site.community\n else \"Drilled Water Well Construction\",\n ],\n details=[\n (\"Client\", site.client),\n (\"Project\", site.project),\n (\"Prepared by\", inputs.prepared_by or site.contractor),\n (\"Date\", site.date),\n ],\n )\n rb.provisional_stamp(inputs.readiness)\n rb.table_of_contents()\n\n # ---- 1 method ------------------------------------------------------\n rb.heading(\"1. Method\", 1)\n rb.paragraph(\n \"The estimate follows the Rural Water Supply Network (RWSN) \"\n \"Cost-Effective Boreholes methodology. Every line item carries a \"\n \"construction stage and a resource category, so the total can be \"\n \"broken down both ways. The estimate first establishes the cost \"\n \"of the works; the contract price is then derived by adding \"\n \"overheads and a margin, and a separate contingency allowance is \"\n \"shown for budget planning. Keeping cost and price apart follows \"\n \"the RWSN guidance for sustainable drilling enterprises.\",\n align=\"justify\",\n )\n rb.paragraph(\n \"The unit rates are indicative values held in an editable \"\n \"catalogue and must be confirmed against current local prices \"\n \"before the estimate is used for contracting.\",\n align=\"justify\",\n )\n\n # ---- 2 basis -------------------------------------------------------\n rb.heading(\"2. Basis of the Estimate\", 1)\n quantities = inputs.estimate.inputs\n rb.table(\n [\n [\"Total depth\", fmt_num(quantities.total_depth_m) + \" m\"],\n [\"Overburden / hard rock\",\n f\"{fmt_num(quantities.overburden_m)} m / {fmt_num(quantities.bedrock_m)} m\"],\n [\"Plain casing / screen\",\n f\"{fmt_num(quantities.casing_m)} m / {fmt_num(quantities.screen_m)} m \"\n f\"({quantities.casing_diameter_in:g} inch)\"],\n [\"Drilled diameter\", f\"{quantities.borehole_diameter_in:g} inch\"],\n [\"Gravel packed interval\", fmt_num(quantities.gravel_interval_m) + \" m\"],\n [\"Mobilisation distance (one way)\",\n fmt_num(quantities.mobilisation_distance_km) + \" km\"],\n [\"Crew time on site\", fmt_num(quantities.crew_days) + \" days\"],\n [\"Development / test pumping\",\n f\"{fmt_num(quantities.development_hours)} h / \"\n f\"{fmt_num(quantities.test_pumping_hours)} h\"],\n [\"Water quality samples\", fmt_num(quantities.wq_samples)],\n [\"Handpumps included\", fmt_num(quantities.handpumps)],\n ],\n header=[\"Quantity driver\", \"Value\"],\n caption=\"Quantities driving the bill of quantities.\",\n )\n if estimate.assumptions:\n rb.paragraph(\"Assumptions applied where inputs were not supplied:\")\n rb.bullets(estimate.assumptions)\n\n # ---- 3 bill of quantities -------------------------------------------\n rb.heading(\"3. Bill of Quantities\", 1)\n rows = [\n [\n r[\"Code\"],\n r[\"Item\"],\n r[\"Unit\"],\n fmt_num(r[\"Quantity\"]),\n f\"{r['Rate (USD)']:,.2f}\",\n f\"{r['Amount (USD)']:,.2f}\",\n ]\n for r in estimate.boq_rows()\n ]\n rb.table(\n rows,\n header=[\"Code\", \"Item\", \"Unit\", \"Qty\", \"Rate (USD)\", \"Amount (USD)\"],\n caption=\"Bill of quantities at the catalogue unit rates.\",\n )\n\n # ---- 4 summary -------------------------------------------------------\n rb.heading(\"4. Cost Summary\", 1)\n rb.table(\n [list(row) for row in estimate.summary_rows()],\n header=[\"Item\", \"USD\", \"SLE\"],\n caption=(\n \"Cost and price roll-up. Local amounts use an exchange rate \"\n f\"of {estimate.exchange_rate_sle_per_usd:g} SLE per USD.\"\n ),\n )\n fig_path = figures / \"cost_breakdown.png\"\n if not fig_path.exists():\n plot_cost_breakdown(estimate, fig_path, config.style)\n rb.figure(fig_path, \"Direct works cost by stage and by resource category.\")\n\n # ---- 5 notes ---------------------------------------------------------\n rb.heading(\"5. Notes and Exclusions\", 1)\n notes = [\n \"Unit rates are indicative and must be confirmed against local \"\n \"supplier and contractor quotations before award.\",\n \"The estimate covers one production borehole; failed or abandoned \"\n \"holes, standby time and exceptional ground conditions are not \"\n \"included and should be covered by the contract conditions.\",\n \"Land access, community mobilisation and post-construction \"\n \"monitoring are excluded.\",\n ]\n for flag in estimate.flags:\n notes.append(str(flag.message))\n rb.bullets(notes)\n\n return rb.save(out_path)\n"}, "groundwater/reporting/docx_utils.py": {"t": "text", "d": "\"\"\"House-styled .docx building blocks.\n\nWraps python-docx with the toolkit's house style: white background,\none accent colour, clean tables, automatic figure and table numbering,\na real table of contents field, page numbers, and a reproducible save\n(fixed zip timestamps so re-running on the same data gives an\nidentical file).\n\nHouse language rules are enforced here: em and en dashes are replaced\nwith plain hyphens and a lint helper flags contractions so template\ntext stays in plain professional English.\n\"\"\"\n\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport re\nimport zipfile\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nimport docx\nfrom docx.enum.section import WD_SECTION\nfrom docx.enum.table import WD_TABLE_ALIGNMENT\nfrom docx.enum.text import WD_ALIGN_PARAGRAPH, WD_BREAK\nfrom docx.oxml import OxmlElement\nfrom docx.oxml.ns import qn\nfrom docx.shared import Cm, Pt, RGBColor\n\nfrom ..config import HouseStyle\n\n_CONTRACTION_RE = re.compile(\n r\"\\b(?:can't|won't|don't|doesn't|didn't|isn't|aren't|wasn't|weren't|\"\n r\"hasn't|haven't|hadn't|shouldn't|couldn't|wouldn't|it's|that's|there's|\"\n r\"what's|let's|they're|we're|you're|i'm|he's|she's|who's|it'll|we'll|\"\n r\"you'll|they'll|i've|we've|you've|they've)\\b\",\n re.IGNORECASE,\n)\n\n\ndef lint_text(text: str) -> list[str]:\n \"\"\"Return house style violations in a piece of report text.\"\"\"\n problems = []\n if \"\u2014\" in text or \"\u2013\" in text:\n problems.append(\"em or en dash present\")\n for match in _CONTRACTION_RE.finditer(text):\n problems.append(f\"contraction '{match.group(0)}'\")\n return problems\n\n\ndef _clean(text: str) -> str:\n \"\"\"Apply the house language rules to outgoing text.\"\"\"\n return text.replace(\"\u2014\", \" - \").replace(\"\u2013\", \"-\")\n\n\ndef _hex_to_rgb(color: str) -> RGBColor:\n color = color.lstrip(\"#\")\n return RGBColor(int(color[0:2], 16), int(color[2:4], 16), int(color[4:6], 16))\n\n\nclass ReportBuilder:\n \"\"\"Assemble a styled report document section by section.\"\"\"\n\n def __init__(self, style: HouseStyle | None = None, title: str = \"Report\"):\n self.style = style or HouseStyle()\n self.doc = docx.Document()\n self.title = title\n self._figure_no = 0\n self._table_no = 0\n self._setup_styles()\n self._setup_page()\n\n # ------------------------------------------------------------------\n # set-up\n # ------------------------------------------------------------------\n\n def _setup_styles(self) -> None:\n accent = _hex_to_rgb(self.style.accent_color)\n normal = self.doc.styles[\"Normal\"]\n normal.font.name = self.style.font_name\n normal.font.size = Pt(self.style.base_font_size_pt)\n normal.paragraph_format.space_after = Pt(6)\n normal.paragraph_format.line_spacing = 1.15\n\n for level, size, bold in ((1, 14, True), (2, 12, True), (3, 11, True)):\n h = self.doc.styles[f\"Heading {level}\"]\n h.font.name = self.style.font_name\n h.font.size = Pt(size)\n h.font.bold = bold\n h.font.color.rgb = accent\n h.paragraph_format.space_before = Pt(12 if level == 1 else 8)\n h.paragraph_format.space_after = Pt(6)\n h.paragraph_format.keep_with_next = True\n\n caption = self.doc.styles[\"Caption\"] if \"Caption\" in [s.name for s in self.doc.styles] else None\n if caption is not None:\n caption.font.name = self.style.font_name\n caption.font.size = Pt(9)\n caption.font.bold = True\n caption.font.color.rgb = RGBColor(0x33, 0x33, 0x33)\n\n def _setup_page(self) -> None:\n section = self.doc.sections[0]\n section.page_width = Cm(21.0)\n section.page_height = Cm(29.7)\n for side in (\"top\", \"bottom\", \"left\", \"right\"):\n setattr(section, f\"{side}_margin\", Cm(2.5))\n self._add_page_numbers(section)\n\n def _add_page_numbers(self, section) -> None:\n footer_para = section.footer.paragraphs[0]\n footer_para.alignment = WD_ALIGN_PARAGRAPH.CENTER\n run = footer_para.add_run()\n for element, text in ((\"begin\", None), (None, \"PAGE\"), (\"end\", None)):\n if element:\n fld = OxmlElement(\"w:fldChar\")\n fld.set(qn(\"w:fldCharType\"), element)\n run._r.append(fld)\n else:\n instr = OxmlElement(\"w:instrText\")\n instr.set(qn(\"xml:space\"), \"preserve\")\n instr.text = \" PAGE \"\n run._r.append(instr)\n run.font.size = Pt(9)\n\n # ------------------------------------------------------------------\n # content\n # ------------------------------------------------------------------\n\n def cover(\n self,\n title_lines: list[str],\n subtitle_lines: list[str] | None = None,\n details: list[tuple[str, self.doc.add_paragraph()\n p.alignment = WD_ALIGN_PARAGRAPH.CENTER\n p.add_run().add_picture(self.style.logo_path, width=Cm(4.5))\n if self.style.organisation:\n p = self.doc.add_paragraph()\n p.alignment = WD_ALIGN_PARAGRAPH.CENTER\n run = p.add_run(_clean(self.style.organisation))\n run.font.size = Pt(14)\n run.font.bold = True\n run.font.color.rgb = _hex_to_rgb(self.style.accent_color)\n if self.style.organisation_details:\n p2 = self.doc.add_paragraph()\n p2.alignment = WD_ALIGN_PARAGRAPH.CENTER\n r2 = p2.add_run(_clean(self.style.organisation_details))\n r2.font.size = Pt(9)\n for _ in range(4):\n self.doc.add_paragraph()\n for line in title_lines:\n p = self.doc.add_paragraph()\n p.alignment = WD_ALIGN_PARAGRAPH.CENTER\n run = p.add_run(_clean(line))\n run.font.size = Pt(20)\n run.font.bold = True\n run.font.color.rgb = _hex_to_rgb(self.style.accent_color)\n for line in subtitle_lines or []:\n p = self.doc.add_paragraph()\n p.alignment = WD_ALIGN_PARAGRAPH.CENTER\n run = p.add_run(_clean(line))\n run.font.size = Pt(13)\n if details:\n for _ in range(3):\n self.doc.add_paragraph()\n for label, value in details:\n p = self.doc.add_paragraph()\n p.alignment = WD_ALIGN_PARAGRAPH.CENTER\n run = p.add_run(f\"{_clean(label)}: \")\n run.font.bold = True\n p.add_run(_clean(str(value)))\n self.page_break()\n\n def provisional_stamp(self, readiness) -> None:\n \"\"\"Say on the cover that this document is not a certification.\n\n A report is what a borehole is handed over on, so one built from\n incomplete evidence must not be indistinguishable from one built\n from complete evidence. A ready project gets no stamp at all; every\n other project gets this, naming exactly what is outstanding or what\n was overridden and by whom, in the document itself rather than in a\n console message nobody keeps.\n \"\"\"\n if readiness is None or readiness.is_certifiable:\n return\n overridden = readiness.state == \"ready_with_overrides\"\n title = (\"ISSUED ON OVERRIDE - NOT A CERTIFICATION\" if overridden\n else \"PROVISIONAL - NOT FOR CERTIFICATION\")\n para = self.doc.add_paragraph()\n para.alignment = WD_ALIGN_PARAGRAPH.CENTER\n run = para.add_run(_clean(title))\n run.font.size = Pt(13)\n run.font.bold = True\n run.font.color.rgb = _hex_to_rgb(\"#B23A2E\")\n\n lead = (\n \"This report was issued although the following requirements were \"\n \"not met. The reason recorded for each is given.\"\n if overridden else\n \"This report rests on incomplete results. The following \"\n \"requirements for certification are outstanding.\"\n )\n self.paragraph(lead, italic=True, align=\"justify\")\n lines = []\n for req in readiness.overridden:\n who = f\" ({req.override_by})\" if req.override_by else \"\"\n reason = req.override_reason or \"no reason recorded\"\n lines.append(f\"{req.title}: {req.detail} Overridden{who}: {reason}\")\n for req in readiness.unmet:\n lines.append(f\"{req.title}: {req.detail}\")\n if lines:\n self.bullets(lines)\n self.page_break()\n\n def table_of_contents(self) -> None:\n self.heading(\"Table of Contents\", level=1, numbered=False)\n para = self.doc.add_paragraph()\n run = para.add_run()\n fld_begin = OxmlElement(\"w:fldChar\")\n fld_begin.set(qn(\"w:fldCharType\"), \"begin\")\n instr = OxmlElement(\"w:instrText\")\n instr.set(qn(\"xml:space\"), \"preserve\")\n instr.text = 'TOC \\\\o \"1-3\" \\\\h \\\\z \\\\u'\n fld_sep = OxmlElement(\"w:fldChar\")\n fld_sep.set(qn(\"w:fldCharType\"), \"separate\")\n placeholder = OxmlElement(\"w:t\")\n placeholder.text = (\n \"Right-click and choose Update Field to fill the table of contents.\"\n )\n fld_end = OxmlElement(\"w:fldChar\")\n fld_end.set(qn(\"w:fldCharType\"), \"end\")\n for el in (fld_begin, instr, fld_sep, placeholder, fld_end):\n run._r.append(el)\n self.page_break()\n\n def executive_summary(\n self, paragraphs: list[str], key_findings: list[str] | None = None\n ) -> None:\n \"\"\"A short verdict block placed at the very top of a report.\n\n Composed from figures the report already computes, so a ministry\n engineer or programme manager gets the yield, water safety and the\n single next action before any detail. ``key_findings`` renders as a\n tight bullet list under a bold label.\n \"\"\"\n self.heading(\"Executive Summary\", level=1, numbered=False)\n for text in paragraphs:\n if not text:\n continue\n self.paragraph(text, align=\"justify\")\n if key_findings:\n self.paragraph(\"Key findings:\", bold=True)\n self.bullets([k for k in key_findings if k])\n self.page_break()\n\n def heading(self, text: str, level: int = 1, numbered: bool = True) -> None:\n self.doc.add_heading(_clean(text), level=level)\n\n def paragraph(self, text: str, bold: bool = False, italic: bool = False,\n align: str | None = None, size_pt: float | None = None):\n p = self.doc.add_paragraph()\n run = p.add_run(_clean(text))\n run.font.bold = bold\n run.font.italic = italic\n if size_pt is not None:\n run.font.size = Pt(size_pt)\n if align == \"center\":\n p.alignment = WD_ALIGN_PARAGRAPH.CENTER\n elif align == \"justify\":\n p.alignment = WD_ALIGN_PARAGRAPH.JUSTIFY\n return p\n\n def bullets(self, items: list[str]) -> None:\n for item in items:\n self.doc.add_paragraph(_clean(item), style=\"List Bullet\")\n\n def references(self, entries: list[str]) -> None:\n \"\"\"A References section with hanging-indent bibliography entries.\"\"\"\n if not entries:\n return\n self.heading(\"References\", level=1, numbered=False)\n for entry in entries:\n para = self.doc.add_paragraph(_clean(entry))\n para.paragraph_format.left_indent = Cm(0.8)\n para.paragraph_format.first_line_indent = Cm(-0.8)\n para.paragraph_format.space_after = Pt(4)\n\n def glossary(self, terms: list[tuple[str, str]]) -> None:\n \"\"\"A two-column glossary and abbreviations table.\"\"\"\n if not terms:\n return\n self.heading(\"Glossary and Abbreviations\", level=1, numbered=False)\n self.table(\n [[term, meaning] for term, meaning in terms],\n header=[\"Term\", \"Meaning\"],\n col_widths_cm=[3.5, 12.0],\n font_size_pt=9.0,\n )\n\n def figure(self, image_path: str | Path, caption: str, width_cm: float = 15.0) -> int:\n \"\"\"Insert an image with an automatic 'Figure N.' caption.\n\n Returns the figure number so body text can reference it.\n \"\"\"\n self._figure_no += 1\n p = self.doc.add_paragraph()\n p.alignment = WD_ALIGN_PARAGRAPH.CENTER\n p.add_run().add_picture(str(image_path), width=Cm(width_cm))\n cap = self.doc.add_paragraph()\n run = cap.add_run(f\"Figure {self._figure_no}. {_clean(caption)}\")\n run.font.size = Pt(9)\n run.font.bold = True\n cap.alignment = WD_ALIGN_PARAGRAPH.CENTER\n return self._figure_no\n\n @property\n def next_figure_number(self) -> int:\n return self._figure_no + 1\n\n @property\n def next_table_number(self) -> int:\n return self._table_no + 1\n\n def table(\n self,\n rows: list[list],\n header: list[str] | None = None,\n caption: str | None = None,\n col_widths_cm: list[float] | None = None,\n font_size_pt: float = 9.5,\n ) -> int:\n \"\"\"Insert a styled table; returns the table number.\n\n The caption goes above the table (report convention). Cell\n values may contain newlines for stacked layer entries.\n \"\"\"\n self._table_no += 1\n if caption:\n cap = self.doc.add_paragraph()\n run = cap.add_run(f\"Table {self._table_no}. {_clean(caption)}\")\n run.font.size = Pt(9)\n run.font.bold = True\n n_cols = len(header) if header else max(len(r) for r in rows)\n table = self.doc.add_table(rows=0, cols=n_cols)\n table.alignment = WD_TABLE_ALIGNMENT.CENTER\n table.style = \"Table Grid\"\n accent = self.style.accent_color.lstrip(\"#\")\n\n if header:\n cells = table.add_row().cells\n for i, text in enumerate(header):\n cells[i].text = \"\"\n para = cells[i].paragraphs[0]\n run = para.add_run(_clean(str(text)))\n run.font.bold = True\n run.font.size = Pt(font_size_pt)\n run.font.color.rgb = RGBColor(0xFF, 0xFF, 0xFF)\n shading = OxmlElement(\"w:shd\")\n shading.set(qn(\"w:val\"), \"clear\")\n shading.set(qn(\"w:fill\"), accent)\n cells[i]._tc.get_or_add_tcPr().append(shading)\n for row in rows:\n cells = table.add_row().cells\n for i, value in enumerate(row):\n if i >= n_cols:\n break\n cells[i].text = \"\"\n para = cells[i].paragraphs[0]\n run = para.add_run(_clean(\"\" if value is None else str(value)))\n run.font.size = Pt(font_size_pt)\n if col_widths_cm:\n for row in table.rows:\n for i, width in enumerate(col_widths_cm[:n_cols]):\n row.cells[i].width = Cm(width)\n self.doc.add_paragraph()\n return self._table_no\n\n def header_block_table(self, pairs: list[tuple[str, str]], font_size_pt: float = 9.5) -> None:\n \"\"\"Two label/value pairs per row, like the field sheet headers.\"\"\"\n table = self.doc.add_table(rows=0, cols=4)\n table.style = \"Table Grid\"\n for i in range(0, len(pairs), 2):\n row = table.add_row().cells\n for j, (label, value) in enumerate(pairs[i : i + 2]):\n cell_label = row[j * 2]\n cell_value = row[j * 2 + 1]\n cell_label.text = \"\"\n run = cell_label.paragraphs[0].add_run(_clean(label))\n run.font.bold = True\n run.font.size = Pt(font_size_pt)\n cell_value.text = \"\"\n run_v = cell_value.paragraphs[0].add_run(_clean(str(value)))\n run_v.font.size = Pt(font_size_pt)\n self.doc.add_paragraph()\n\n def signature_block(\n self, name: str, role: str, phone: str = \"\", organisation: str = \"\", email: str = \"\"\n ) -> None:\n self.paragraph(\"REPORT SUBMITTED BY:\", bold=True)\n self.doc.add_paragraph()\n self.doc.add_paragraph()\n self.paragraph(\".\" * 30)\n self.paragraph(name, bold=True)\n p = self.paragraph(role)\n p.runs[0].font.italic = True\n if organisation:\n self.paragraph(organisation)\n if phone:\n self.paragraph(f\"Cell: {phone}\")\n if email:\n self.paragraph(f\"Email: {email}\")\n\n def page_break(self) -> None:\n self.doc.add_paragraph().add_run().add_break(WD_BREAK.PAGE)\n\n # ------------------------------------------------------------------\n # save\n # ------------------------------------------------------------------\n\n def save(self, path: str | Path) -> Path:\n path = Path(path)\n path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)\n core = self.doc.core_properties\n core.title = self.title\n core.author = self.style.organisation or \"Groundwater Toolkit\"\n self.doc.save(path)\n _normalise_zip_timestamps(path)\n return path\n\n\ndef _normalise_zip_timestamps(path: Path) -> None:\n \"\"\"Rewrite the .docx zip with fixed timestamps and sorted entries so\n identical content produces an identical file.\"\"\"\n with zipfile.ZipFile(path, \"r\") as zin:\n entries = sorted(zin.namelist())\n contents = {name: zin.read(name) for name in entries}\n with zipfile.ZipFile(path, \"w\", zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED) as zout:\n for name in entries:\n info = zipfile.ZipInfo(name, date_time=(2020, 1, 1, 0, 0, 0))\n info.compress_type = zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED\n info.external_attr = 0o600 << 16\n zout.writestr(info, contents[name])\n"}, "groundwater/reporting/geophysical.py": {"t": "text", "d": "\"\"\"Geophysical survey report generator.\n\nFollows the structure of the Rokel example report: table of contents,\nintroduction, background and geology of the project area, field work\n(reconnaissance with geomorphology and hydrogeology, traverse and VES\npoint selection, then survey method and instrument), data analysis\nwith one block per sounding (header and data table, curve and model\nfigure, layer pseudo-section, interpretation paragraph), the ranked\ntable of VES points in order of drilling preference, conclusions and\nrecommendations, and a signature block.\n\nEvery figure and table is numbered by the builder and referenced from\nthe body text; every number in the tables comes from the parsed raw\ndata or the fitted models.\n\"\"\"\n\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom dataclasses import dataclass, field\nfrom pathlib import Path\nfrom typing import Any\n\nfrom
