..config import Config\nfrom ..geo import infer_zone_for_sierra_leone\nfrom ..mapping import suitability_map\nfrom ..models import DataFlag, VESSounding\nfrom ..siting import assess_siting, suitability_map_points\nfrom ..utils import fmt_num, safe_slug\nfrom ..ves.classify import classify_curve\nfrom ..ves.interpret import SiteInterpretation, drilling_preference_table\nfrom ..ves.inversion import InversionResult\nfrom ..ves.plots import plot_model_pseudosection, plot_sounding_curve\nfrom .citations import GLOSSARY, references_for\nfrom .context import context_map_figures\nfrom .docx_utils import ReportBuilder\n\n_DEFAULT_GEOLOGY = (\n \"The project area lies within the crystalline basement terrain of Sierra \"\n \"Leone, where groundwater occurs mainly within the weathered overburden \"\n \"(regolith) and in fractured zones of the underlying bedrock. The \"\n \"weathered zone develops on granites, gneisses and related rocks, and its \"\n \"thickness and degree of fracturing control the groundwater potential. \"\n \"Groundwater quality and quantity can be favourable where the borehole \"\n \"position is properly located through appropriate hydrogeological and \"\n \"geophysical investigations.\"\n)\n\n_FREETOWN_GEOLOGY = (\n \"The project area lies within the Freetown Basic Complex. The Freetown \"\n \"Complex is a layered gabbroic anorthosite intrusion emplaced against \"\n \"gneisses and schists of the Kasila Group, and it forms part of the \"\n \"Peninsula and Banana Islands. It is thought to have been formed by \"\n \"multiple injections of magma that occurred intermittently. Groundwater \"\n \"potential within the Freetown Basic Complex is found within weathered \"\n \"and fractured zones of these igneous (crystalline) rocks. Groundwater \"\n \"quality and quantity can be high if the borehole is properly located \"\n \"through appropriate hydrogeological and geophysical investigations.\"\n)\n\n\n@dataclass\nclass GeophysicalReportInputs:\n \"\"\"Everything the geophysical survey report needs.\"\"\"\n\n soundings: list[VESSounding]\n inversions: list[InversionResult]\n interpretations: list[SiteInterpretation]\n figures_dir: Path\n site_map_path: Path | None = None\n survey_photo_path: Path | None = None\n geology_text: str = \"\"\n reconnaissance_date: str = \"\"\n reconnaissance_notes: str = \"\"\n profiling_note: str = \"\"\n geologist_name: str = \"\"\n geologist_role: str = \"Geologist / Field Supervisor\"\n geologist_phone: str = \"\"\n flags: list[DataFlag] = field(default_factory=list)\n include_qa_annex: bool = False\n #: :class:`~groundwater.readiness.Readiness` for this report, from\n #: :func:`groundwater.readiness.assess_readiness`. When it is not\n #: certifiable the cover carries a PROVISIONAL stamp listing why.\n readiness: Any = None\n\n\ndef _geology_for(district: str, override: str) -> str:\n if override:\n return override\n if \"western\" in (district or \"\").lower():\n return _FREETOWN_GEOLOGY\n return _DEFAULT_GEOLOGY\n\n\ndef build_geophysical_report(\n inputs: GeophysicalReportInputs,\n out_path: str | Path,\n config: Config | None = None,\n) -> Path:\n \"\"\"Write the geophysical survey report to ``out_path`` (.docx).\"\"\"\n config = config or Config()\n soundings = inputs.soundings\n if not soundings:\n raise ValueError(\"At least one sounding is required\")\n site = soundings[0].site\n community = site.community or \"the project area\"\n district = site.district or \"\"\n client = site.client or \"the client\"\n\n rb = ReportBuilder(config.style, title=f\"Geophysical Survey Report - {community}\")\n\n # ---- cover -------------------------------------------------------------\n rb.cover(\n title_lines=[\"GEOPHYSICAL SURVEY REPORT\"],\n subtitle_lines=[\n \"Groundwater Investigation for Borehole Siting\",\n f\"at {community}\" + (f\", {district} District\" if district and \"western\" not in district.lower() else f\", {district}\" if district else \"\"),\n ],\n details=[\n (\"Client\", client),\n (\"Project\", site.project or \"Geophysical Survey\"),\n (\"Survey date\", soundings[0].site.date or \"\"),\n (\"Prepared by\", inputs.geologist_name or config.style.organisation or \"\"),\n ],\n )\n rb.provisional_stamp(inputs.readiness)\n\n # ---- table of contents ---------------------------------------------------\n rb.table_of_contents()\n\n # ---- executive summary ---------------------------------------------------\n exec_paras, exec_key = _executive_summary(soundings, inputs.interpretations,\n community, district)\n rb.executive_summary(exec_paras, exec_key)\n\n # ---- 1 introduction --------------------------------------------------------\n rb.heading(\"1. Introduction\", 1)\n rb.paragraph(\n \"Geological and hydrogeological/geophysical investigations are \"\n f\"prerequisites for borehole drilling. {client} requested a \"\n \"geophysical investigation to site the borehole position at \"\n f\"{community}\" + (f\" in {district}\" if district else \"\") + \". \"\n \"The study assessed the possibility of accessing groundwater in the \"\n \"project area, and the details of the investigations are documented \"\n \"in this report.\",\n align=\"justify\",\n )\n\n # ---- 2 background / geology ---------------------------------------------\n rb.heading(\"2. Background and Geology of the Project Area\", 1)\n rb.paragraph(_geology_for(district, inputs.geology_text), align=\"justify\")\n context_maps = context_map_figures(site, inputs.figures_dir, config.style)\n if context_maps:\n rb.figure(\n context_maps[\"admin\"],\n f\"Location of {community}. Boundaries from geoBoundaries \"\n \"(CC BY 4.0).\",\n )\n rb.figure(\n context_maps[\"hydrogeology\"],\n \"Aquifer type and productivity around the site, from the BGS \"\n \"Africa Groundwater Atlas country map (CC BY-SA 4.0).\",\n )\n rb.figure(\n context_maps[\"geology\"],\n \"Geological setting around the site, from the USGS Geologic \"\n \"Map of Africa (1:5,000,000). The Geology of Sierra Leone map \"\n \"(Ministry of Water Resources/SALWACO, 2017) gives the \"\n \"detailed local formations.\",\n )\n\n # ---- 3 field work -----------------------------------------------------------\n rb.heading(\"3. Field Work\", 1)\n rb.heading(\"3.1 Reconnaissance Survey\", 2)\n recon_date = inputs.reconnaissance_date or site.date\n rb.paragraph(\n \"The aim of the reconnaissance survey was to select suitable points \"\n \"for the geophysical survey. Existing water points, environmental \"\n \"and other physical conditions were also assessed.\"\n + (f\" The field reconnaissance survey was conducted on {recon_date}.\" if recon_date else \"\"),\n align=\"justify\",\n )\n rb.paragraph(\"Geomorphological survey of the area\", bold=True)\n rb.paragraph(\n inputs.reconnaissance_notes\n or (\n \"The landscape and other physical features of the area were \"\n \"examined, including slopes, drainage lines and streams, since \"\n \"there is normally hydraulic continuity between groundwater and \"\n \"surface water.\"\n ),\n align=\"justify\",\n )\n rb.paragraph(\n \"Geological and hydrogeological survey to determine the formation \"\n \"of the area and identify possible features\",\n bold=True,\n )\n rb.paragraph(\n \"The weathered products overlying the bedrock were assessed as the \"\n \"principal prospect for groundwater, since groundwater occurs mostly \"\n \"in weathered and unconsolidated materials compared with \"\n \"consolidated and crystalline rocks.\",\n align=\"justify\",\n )\n if inputs.site_map_path and Path(inputs.site_map_path).exists():\n rb.figure(inputs.site_map_path, f\"Topographic map of the project area at {community}.\")\n\n rb.paragraph(\"Selection of traverse line for the geophysical survey\", bold=True)\n rb.paragraph(\n \"The traverse line for the resistivity survey was selected on the \"\n \"basis of geomorphologic and geological/hydrogeological features as \"\n \"well as the location of the project area. Points for the vertical \"\n \"electrical soundings were selected considering the available space \"\n \"and the environmental and other physical conditions, and the \"\n \"proposed borehole locations were marked with pegs for \"\n \"identification.\",\n align=\"justify\",\n )\n\n rb.heading(\"3.2 Geophysical Survey\", 2)\n instrument = soundings[0].instrument or \"Syscal Junior\"\n rb.paragraph(\n \"The geophysical survey consisted of electrical resistivity \"\n \"measurements, specifically vertical electrical sounding (VES) \"\n f\"using the {instrument} instrument.\",\n align=\"justify\",\n )\n if inputs.survey_photo_path and Path(inputs.survey_photo_path).exists():\n rb.figure(\n inputs.survey_photo_path,\n f\"Geophysical survey using the {instrument} equipment.\",\n )\n\n rb.heading(\"3.2.1 Resistivity Profiling\", 3)\n rb.paragraph(\n inputs.profiling_note\n or (\n \"Electrical resistivity profiling is usually carried out along a \"\n \"selected traverse of 50 m to 100 m length at 10 m intervals to \"\n \"determine the lateral variation of subsurface resistivities and \"\n \"delineate anomalous points with groundwater potential. Where \"\n \"the available land extent does not permit profiling, the \"\n \"vertical electrical soundings are carried out at the selected \"\n \"points directly.\"\n ),\n align=\"justify\",\n )\n\n rb.heading(\"3.2.2 Selection of VES Points\", 3)\n labels = \", \".join(s.sounding_id for s in soundings)\n rb.paragraph(\n f\"{len(soundings)} vertical electrical sounding point(s) were \"\n \"selected based on the available space and the location of the \"\n \"project area, considering geological, hydrogeological and \"\n f\"environmental conditions. The points are labelled {labels} in \"\n \"this report.\",\n align=\"justify\",\n )\n\n rb.heading(\"3.2.3 Vertical Electrical Sounding (VES)\", 3)\n rb.paragraph(\n \"Vertical electrical soundings were carried out with the aim of \"\n \"determining the formation resistivities and the depth to bedrock, \"\n \"as well as the possibility of finding water bearing fractures or \"\n \"aquifers at depth with their corresponding thicknesses. The \"\n \"Schlumberger electrode configuration and the required procedures \"\n \"were used for the soundings.\",\n align=\"justify\",\n )\n\n # ---- 4 data analysis ------------------------------------------------------\n rb.heading(\"4. Data Analysis and Interpretation\", 1)\n for sounding, inversion, interp in zip(\n soundings, inputs.inversions, inputs.interpretations\n ):\n _sounding_block(rb, sounding, inversion, interp, inputs.figures_dir)\n\n # ---- preference table -----------------------------------------------------\n rows = drilling_preference_table(inputs.interpretations)\n header = list(rows[0].keys()) if rows else []\n rb.table(\n [[row[h] for h in header] for row in rows],\n header=header,\n caption=\"List of VES points in order of preference for drilling.\",\n font_size_pt=8.5,\n )\n\n # ---- drill-target suitability --------------------------------------------\n _suitability_block(rb, inputs, site)\n\n # ---- 5 conclusions and recommendations -------------------------------------\n rb.heading(\"5. Conclusions and Recommendations\", 1)\n rb.paragraph(\"Conclusions:\", bold=True)\n conclusions = _conclusions(inputs.interpretations, district, community)\n rb.bullets(conclusions)\n rb.paragraph(\"Recommendations:\", bold=True)\n rb.bullets(_recommendations(inputs.interpretations))\n\n # ---- 6 limitations and uncertainty -----------------------------------------\n rb.heading(\"6. Limitations and Uncertainty\", 1)\n rb.bullets(_limitations(inputs.inversions))\n\n # ---- QA annex (optional) -----------------------------------------------------\n if inputs.include_qa_annex and inputs.flags:\n rb.heading(\"Annex A. Data Verification Notes\", 1)\n rb.paragraph(\n \"The following checks were raised automatically during data \"\n \"processing and should be verified against the field notes.\"\n )\n rb.bullets([str(f) for f in inputs.flags])\n\n # ---- references and glossary -----------------------------------------------\n rb.references(references_for(\"geophysical\"))\n rb.glossary(GLOSSARY)\n\n # ---- signature ------------------------------------------------------------\n rb.signature_block(\n name=inputs.geologist_name or soundings[0].site.supervisor or \"\",\n role=inputs.geologist_role,\n phone=inputs.geologist_phone,\n organisation=config.style.organisation,\n )\n\n return rb.save(out_path)\n\n\ndef _limitations(inversions: list[InversionResult]) -> list[str]:\n \"\"\"Honest, calibrated limitations for the VES interpretation.\"\"\"\n items = [\n \"Resistivity models are not unique: different layered models can fit \"\n \"the same sounding curve almost equally well (the equivalence and \"\n \"suppression problem), so the interpreted layer depths and \"\n \"thicknesses carry an uncertainty of the order of plus or minus 20 \"\n \"percent.\",\n \"A low resistivity layer can represent either a saturated, water \"\n \"bearing zone or a conductive clay; the interpretation is made from \"\n \"the geological context and must be confirmed by drilling.\",\n \"The depth of investigation is limited to roughly the maximum \"\n \"electrode spacing, so any structure below the deepest reliable depth \"\n \"is not resolved.\",\n \"The survey indicates groundwater potential only. The actual yield and \"\n \"water quality can be confirmed only by test drilling, test pumping \"\n \"and laboratory analysis.\",\n ]\n errs = [inv.fit_error_percent for inv in inversions if inv.fit_error_percent is not None]\n if errs:\n items.insert(\n 0,\n f\"The fitted models reproduce the measured apparent resistivities \"\n f\"to within {max(errs):.1f} percent (ERR); a larger misfit means a \"\n \"less certain model.\",\n )\n return items\n\n\n\ndef _site_slug(site) -> str:\n \"\"\"Filename fragment identifying the survey site.\"\"\"\n return safe_slug(getattr(site, \"community\", \"\") or \"site\", \"site\")\n\n\ndef _sounding_block(\n rb: ReportBuilder,\n sounding: VESSounding,\n inversion: InversionResult,\n interp: SiteInterpretation,\n figures_dir: Path,\n) -> None:\n \"\"\"One data analysis block per sounding: tables, figures, narrative.\"\"\"\n site = sounding.site\n sid = sounding.sounding_id\n # site as well as sounding id: two surveys both with a sounding \"A\"\n # share one figures directory in an app session, and generation is\n # guarded by an existence check, so the second reused the first's curve.\n safe_id = f\"{_site_slug(site)}_{safe_slug(sid, 'ves')}\"\n\n # data table with the field sheet header block\n table_no = rb.next_table_number\n rb.paragraph(\n f\"Table {table_no} presents the Schlumberger array VES data recorded \"\n f\"at point {sid}, from which the sounding curve of apparent \"\n \"resistivity against half the current electrode spacing (AB/2) in \"\n f\"Figure {rb.next_figure_number} is plotted.\",\n align=\"justify\",\n )\n rb.header_block_table(\n [\n (\"Client\", site.client), (\"Community\", site.community),\n (\"Project\", site.project or \"Geophysical Survey\"), (\"Sounding Number\", sid),\n (\"District\", site.district), (\"GPS Coordinate East\", fmt_num(site.easting, 7)),\n (\"Date\", site.date), (\"GPS Coordinate North\", fmt_num(site.northing, 7)),\n (\"Field Supervisor\", site.supervisor), (\"Elevation\", fmt_num(site.elevation_m) + \" m\" if site.elevation_m else \"\"),\n ]\n )\n rows = [\n [i + 1, fmt_num(a), fmt_num(m), fmt_num(r, 4)]\n for i, (a, m, r) in enumerate(zip(sounding.ab2, sounding.mn, sounding.rho_app))\n ]\n rb.table(\n rows,\n header=[\"No.\", \"AB/2 (m)\", \"MN (m)\", \"Apparent Resistivity (ohm-m)\"],\n caption=f\"Schlumberger array VES data at point {sid}.\",\n col_widths_cm=[1.5, 3.0, 3.0, 7.0],\n )\n\n # curve + model figure\n curve_path = figures_dir / f\"ves_curve_{safe_id}.png\"\n if not curve_path.exists():\n plot_sounding_curve(\n sounding, inversion.model, inversion.rho_calc, inversion.ab2, path=curve_path\n )\n rb.figure(curve_path, f\"Schlumberger array VES curve and model at point {sid}.\")\n\n # model table (IPI2Win layout) with linearised uncertainty factors\n rho_fac = inversion.rho_uncertainty_factor\n h_fac = inversion.h_uncertainty_factor\n model_rows = []\n for i, row in enumerate(inversion.model.as_table()):\n rho_cell = fmt_num(row[\"rho_ohm_m\"], 4)\n if rho_fac is not None and i < len(rho_fac):\n rho_cell += f\" (x/ {rho_fac[i]:.1f})\"\n if row[\"h_m\"] is not None:\n h_cell = fmt_num(row[\"h_m\"])\n if h_fac is not None and i < len(h_fac):\n h_cell += f\" (x/ {h_fac[i]:.1f})\"\n else:\n h_cell = \"\"\n model_rows.append(\n [\n row[\"N\"],\n rho_cell,\n h_cell,\n \"0/0\" if row[\"z_m\"] == \"0/0\" else fmt_num(row[\"z_m\"]),\n ]\n )\n err = inversion.fit_error_percent\n rb.table(\n model_rows,\n header=[\"N\", \"rho (ohm-m)\", \"h (m)\", \"z (m)\"],\n caption=(\n f\"Layered earth model at point {sid} \"\n f\"(curve type {classify_curve(inversion.model)}, ERR = {err:.1f}%). \"\n \"The (x/ factor) is the linearised 1-sigma uncertainty; a factor \"\n \"near 1 is well resolved and a large factor marks equivalence.\"\n ),\n col_widths_cm=[1.2, 4.6, 3.4, 2.8],\n )\n\n # pseudo-section figure\n pseudo_path = figures_dir / f\"ves_pseudosection_{safe_id}.png\"\n if not pseudo_path.exists():\n plot_model_pseudosection(\n inversion.model,\n path=pseudo_path,\n depth_max=interp.investigation_depth_m * 0.5,\n title=f\"Layer section at {sid}\",\n )\n rb.figure(\n pseudo_path,\n f\"Pseudo-section showing resistivity and layer thicknesses at point {sid}.\",\n )\n\n # interpretation paragraph\n rb.paragraph(interp.narrative, align=\"justify\")\n rb.page_break()\n\n\ndef _suitability_block(rb: ReportBuilder, inputs, site) -> None:\n \"\"\"Ranked drill-target suitability scorecard, map and recommendation.\"\"\"\n suit = assess_siting(inputs.interpretations)\n if not suit:\n return\n rb.heading(\"Drill-target suitability\", 2)\n rb.paragraph(\n \"Each surveyed point is given a transparent suitability score from 0 \"\n \"to 100. The score combines the interpreted water-bearing thickness, \"\n \"how well the resistivity of the water zone sits within the productive \"\n \"fractured or weathered window, the overburden profile, and the \"\n \"presence of a fractured zone at the basement contact. The scores \"\n \"rank the points as drilling targets.\",\n align=\"justify\",\n )\n rb.table(\n [[s.rank, s.sounding_id, f\"{s.suitability:.0f}\", s.grade] for s in suit],\n header=[\"Rank\", \"VES point\", \"Suitability (0 to 100)\", \"Grade\"],\n caption=\"Drill-target suitability of the surveyed points.\",\n col_widths_cm=[1.8, 4.0, 4.5, 3.7],\n )\n best = suit[0]\n # The rest of the report (executive summary, conclusions, recommendations,\n # drilling-preference table) selects the preferred point by interpretation\n # score. Anchor the recommendation here to that same point so the document\n # never recommends one point in the summary and a different one here; where\n # the suitability scorecard's top differs, surface it as a note rather than\n # a competing recommendation.\n preferred_id = min(\n inputs.interpretations, key=lambda i: (-i.score, i.sounding_id)\n ).sounding_id\n preferred = next((s for s in suit if s.sounding_id == preferred_id), best)\n if preferred.sounding_id == best.sounding_id:\n rb.paragraph(\n f\"Point {best.sounding_id} has the highest suitability \"\n f\"({best.suitability:.0f} out of 100, {best.grade.lower()}) and is the \"\n f\"recommended drilling target. {best.rationale}\",\n align=\"justify\",\n )\n else:\n rb.paragraph(\n f\"The recommended drilling target is point {preferred.sounding_id} \"\n f\"(suitability {preferred.suitability:.0f} out of 100, \"\n f\"{preferred.grade.lower()}), consistent with the ranked results \"\n f\"elsewhere in this report. Point {best.sounding_id} scores highest \"\n f\"on the suitability scorecard ({best.suitability:.0f}); where the two \"\n \"measures differ, confirm the choice against the site conditions. \"\n f\"{preferred.rationale}\",\n align=\"justify\",\n )\n map_points = suitability_map_points(suit)\n if map_points:\n zone = site.utm_zone or infer_zone_for_sierra_leone(map_points[0].easting)\n smap = Path(inputs.figures_dir) / f\"suitability_map_{_site_slug(site)}.png\"\n if not smap.exists():\n suitability_map(map_points, zone, path=smap)\n rb.figure(\n smap,\n \"Drill-target suitability of the surveyed points; greener is more \"\n \"suitable, and any interpolated surface is limited to the area \"\n \"actually covered by the survey.\",\n )\n\n\ndef _executive_summary(\n soundings: list[VESSounding],\n interpretations: list[SiteInterpretation],\n community: str,\n district: str,\n) -> tuple[list[str], list[str]]:\n \"\"\"Compose the geophysical executive summary from the ranked results.\"\"\"\n # Select the preferred point by the same key drilling_preference_table\n # uses (highest score, then sounding id). This does not rely on .rank,\n # which is only assigned later when that table is built, so the summary\n # is deterministic however many times the report is regenerated.\n best = min(interpretations, key=lambda i: (-i.score, i.sounding_id))\n n = len(soundings)\n zones = best.water_zones\n if zones:\n zone_txt = \"; \".join(f\"{int(t)} m to {int(b)} m\" for t, b in zones)\n zone_sentence = (\n \"The most promising water bearing zone at the preferred point \"\n f\"lies between {zone_txt}.\"\n )\n else:\n zone_txt = \"\"\n zone_sentence = (\n \"No strongly water bearing zone was resolved at the preferred \"\n \"point within the investigated depth, so the result should be \"\n \"confirmed by test drilling.\"\n )\n para = (\n f\"A geophysical siting survey using {n} vertical electrical sounding \"\n f\"point(s) was carried out at {community}\"\n + (f\", {district}\" if district else \"\")\n + f\". Point {best.sounding_id} is recommended as the preferred \"\n f\"drilling location, to a depth of about {best.max_drilling_depth_m:.0f} m. \"\n + zone_sentence\n )\n key = [\n f\"Preferred drilling point: {best.sounding_id}.\",\n f\"Recommended drilling depth: about {best.max_drilling_depth_m:.0f} m.\",\n ]\n if zone_txt:\n key.append(f\"Target water zone(s): {zone_txt}.\")\n key.append(\n \"Yield and water quality can only be confirmed by test drilling and \"\n \"test pumping.\"\n )\n return [para], key\n\n\ndef _conclusions(\n interpretations: list[SiteInterpretation], district: str, community: str\n) -> list[str]:\n items = []\n if district and \"western\" in district.lower():\n items.append(\n \"The project area is part of the Freetown Basic Complex \"\n \"lithological formation.\"\n )\n items.append(\n \"Groundwater potential (quality and quantity) could be favourable at \"\n \"depth within weathered zones and fractured bedrock.\"\n )\n for interp in interpretations:\n if interp.water_zones:\n zones = \" and \".join(f\"{int(t)} m to {int(b)} m\" for t, b in interp.water_zones)\n items.append(\n f\"The potential water zones at point {interp.sounding_id} are \"\n f\"found between {zones}.\"\n )\n else:\n items.append(\n f\"No clearly water bearing zone was resolved at point \"\n f\"{interp.sounding_id} within the investigated depth.\"\n )\n best = min(interpretations, key=lambda i: i.rank or 99)\n items.append(\n f\"Point {best.sounding_id} is selected as the preferred point for \"\n \"drilling according to the results and data analysis.\"\n )\n items.append(\n \"It is premature to estimate quantities, which can only be \"\n \"determined during test drilling and test pumping.\"\n )\n items.append(\n \"The borehole locations were selected within both national and \"\n \"international borehole siting guidelines.\"\n )\n return items\n\n\ndef _recommendations(interpretations: list[SiteInterpretation]) -> list[str]:\n best = min(interpretations, key=lambda i: i.rank or 99)\n others = [i for i in interpretations if i is not best]\n items = [\n f\"Drilling should be carried out at the selected point \"\n f\"{best.sounding_id} to confirm the existence of groundwater.\"\n ]\n if others:\n items.append(\n \"Point(s) \"\n + \", \".join(i.sounding_id for i in others)\n + \" are optional drilling points.\"\n )\n depths = \"; \".join(\n f\"{i.max_drilling_depth_m:.0f} m at point {i.sounding_id}\"\n for i in sorted(interpretations, key=lambda i: i.rank or 99)\n )\n items.append(\n f\"The maximum drilling depth should be {depths}, to cut across the \"\n \"probable water zones for sustainable productivity and a high yield \"\n \"of the borehole(s).\"\n )\n items.append(\n \"The borehole must be constructed using correct and standard \"\n \"materials such as standard uPVC screens and plain casings and well \"\n \"sorted gravel pack.\"\n )\n items.append(\n \"Both physico-chemical and bacteriological tests should be carried \"\n \"out on water samples from the completed well.\"\n )\n return items\n"}, "groundwater/reporting/handover.py": {"t": "text", "d": "\"\"\"Project handover report generator.\n\nThe closing deliverable for the client, NGO or government partner: a\nproject summary, the works completed, the borehole data sheet with all\nkey results, the as-built design drawing, the water quality verdict,\noperation and maintenance guidance, the community/WASH committee\ndetails, recommendations and the handover signature blocks.\n\"\"\"\n\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom typing import Any\n\nfrom dataclasses import dataclass, field\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nfrom ..config import Config\nfrom ..design.designer import BoreholeDesign\nfrom ..design.drawing import draw_borehole_design\nfrom ..hydraulics.analysis import PumpingTestAnalysis\nfrom ..models import DrillingLog, SiteMetadata\nfrom ..quality.assess import (\n SUITABILITY_PHRASE,\n SUITABILITY_SENTENCE,\n WaterQualityAssessment,\n)\nfrom ..utils import fmt_num, safe_slug\nfrom .citations import GLOSSARY, references_for\nfrom .context import context_map_figures\nfrom .docx_utils import ReportBuilder\n\n_OM_GUIDANCE = [\n (\n \"Daily\",\n [\n \"Keep the apron and surroundings clean; no washing or animal \"\n \"watering on the apron.\",\n \"Check for leaks, unusual pump noise and discoloured water.\",\n \"Keep the drainage channel and soakaway free flowing.\",\n ],\n ),\n (\n \"Weekly\",\n [\n \"Tighten loose bolts on the pump head and inspect the apron for cracks.\",\n \"Record the approximate hours of use or strokes per day.\",\n ],\n ),\n (\n \"Monthly\",\n [\n \"Measure and record the water level where a dip access exists.\",\n \"Collect the agreed user fees and update the cash book.\",\n \"Inspect the fence and the sanitary protection zone (no pit \"\n \"latrine, refuse pit or animal pen within 30 m).\",\n ],\n ),\n (\n \"Yearly\",\n [\n \"Service the pump according to the manufacturer schedule and \"\n \"replace fast wearing parts.\",\n \"Repeat the physico-chemical and bacteriological water tests.\",\n \"Review the tariff against the cost of spare parts.\",\n ],\n ),\n]\n\n\n@dataclass\nclass CommitteeMember:\n role: str\n name: str\n phone: str = \"\"\n\n\n@dataclass\nclass HandoverReportInputs:\n site: SiteMetadata\n log: DrillingLog | None = None\n design: BoreholeDesign | None = None\n pumping: PumpingTestAnalysis | None = None\n quality: WaterQualityAssessment | None = None\n figures_dir: Path = Path(\".\")\n works_completed: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)\n committee: list[CommitteeMember] = field(default_factory=list)\n committee_notes: str = \"\"\n tariff_note: str = \"\"\n pump_type: str = \"\"\n extra_recommendations: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)\n contractor_rep: str = \"\"\n client_rep: str = \"\"\n community_rep: str = \"\"\n #: The certification gate for this report, from\n #: :func:`groundwater.readiness.assess_readiness`. When it is not\n #: certifiable the cover says so; when it is absent nothing is\n #: stamped, so an existing caller is unaffected.\n readiness: Any = None\n\n\ndef build_handover_report(\n inputs: HandoverReportInputs,\n out_path: str | Path,\n config: Config | None = None,\n) -> Path:\n config = config or Config()\n site = inputs.site\n figures = Path(inputs.figures_dir)\n figures.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)\n # Qualify figure filenames with the site: several reports share one\n # figures directory in an app session and generation is guarded by an\n # existence check, so fixed names made the second report silently reuse\n # the first site's figures.\n slug = safe_slug(site.community, \"site\")\n\n rb = ReportBuilder(config.style, title=f\"Handover Report - {site.community}\")\n rb.cover(\n title_lines=[\"PROJECT HANDOVER REPORT\"],\n subtitle_lines=[\n \"Borehole Water Supply\",\n f\"at {site.community}\" + (f\", {site.district} District\" if site.district else \"\"),\n ],\n details=[\n (\"Client\", site.client),\n (\"Project\", site.project),\n (\"Contractor\", site.contractor),\n (\"Date\", site.date),\n ],\n )\n rb.provisional_stamp(inputs.readiness)\n rb.table_of_contents()\n\n # ---- executive summary ----------------------------------------------------\n exec_paras, exec_key = _executive_summary(inputs)\n rb.executive_summary(exec_paras, exec_key)\n\n # ---- 1 project summary ----------------------------------------------------\n rb.heading(\"1. Project Summary\", 1)\n lat_lon = site.latlon\n rb.header_block_table(\n [\n (\"Community\", site.community), (\"Chiefdom\", site.chiefdom),\n (\"District\", site.district), (\"Client\", site.client),\n (\"Contractor\", site.contractor), (\"Project reference\", site.project_ref),\n (\"GPS East\", fmt_num(site.easting, 7) if site.easting is not None else \"\"),\n (\"GPS North\", fmt_num(site.northing, 7) if site.northing is not None else \"\"),\n (\"Latitude / Longitude\",\n f\"{lat_lon[0]:.5f} N, {abs(lat_lon[1]):.5f} W\" if lat_lon else \"\"),\n (\"Elevation\",\n fmt_num(site.elevation_m) + \" m\" if site.elevation_m is not None else \"\"),\n ]\n )\n context_maps = context_map_figures(site, figures, config.style)\n if context_maps:\n rb.figure(\n context_maps[\"admin\"],\n \"Location of the water point. Boundaries from geoBoundaries \"\n \"(CC BY 4.0).\",\n )\n\n # ---- 2 works completed ---------------------------------------------------------\n rb.heading(\"2. Works Completed\", 1)\n works = inputs.works_completed or _default_works(inputs)\n rb.bullets(works)\n\n # ---- 3 borehole data sheet ---------------------------------------------------\n rb.heading(\"3. Borehole Data Sheet\", 1)\n rows: list[list[str]] = []\n log = inputs.log\n if log is not None:\n rows += [\n [\"Borehole reference\", log.borehole_ref],\n [\"Total depth\", fmt_num(log.total_depth_m) + \" m\"],\n [\"Drilling method\", log.drilling_method],\n [\"Water strikes\", \", \".join(f\"{w:g} m\" for w in log.water_strikes_m) or \"n/a\"],\n [\"Completion date\", log.completion_date],\n [\"Status\", log.status],\n ]\n if inputs.design is not None:\n rows += [[k, v] for k, v in inputs.design.summary_rows()]\n analysis = inputs.pumping\n if analysis is not None:\n if analysis.transmissivity_m2_per_day:\n rows.append([\"Transmissivity\", fmt_num(analysis.transmissivity_m2_per_day) + \" m2/day\"])\n yr = analysis.yield_recommendation\n if yr is not None:\n if yr.safe_yield_m3_per_h:\n rows.append([\n f\"Safe yield (safety factor {yr.safety_factor:g})\",\n yr.yield_range_text,\n ])\n if yr.pump_installation_depth_m:\n rows.append([\"Pump installation depth\", fmt_num(yr.pump_installation_depth_m) + \" m\"])\n if inputs.pump_type:\n rows.append([\"Pump type\", inputs.pump_type])\n rb.table(rows, header=[\"Item\", \"Value\"], caption=\"Key borehole data.\")\n\n if inputs.design is not None:\n design_fig = figures / f\"borehole_design_{slug}.png\"\n if not design_fig.exists():\n draw_borehole_design(\n inputs.design, log, path=design_fig, style=config.style,\n title=f\"Borehole design - {site.community}\",\n )\n rb.figure(design_fig, \"As-built borehole diagram.\", width_cm=13.0)\n\n # ---- 4 water quality ------------------------------------------------------------\n rb.heading(\"4. Water Quality\", 1)\n if inputs.quality is not None:\n rb.paragraph(inputs.quality.verdict, align=\"justify\")\n # every exceedance, national ones included: a national breach is a\n # compliance failure and must appear in the table, not be dropped\n exceed = inputs.quality.all_exceedances\n if exceed:\n rb.table(\n [[r.parameter, fmt_num(r.value), r.unit, r.remark] for r in exceed],\n header=[\"Parameter\", \"Value\", \"Unit\", \"Remark\"],\n caption=\"Parameters above guideline or standard limits.\",\n )\n else:\n rb.paragraph(\"Water quality results are reported separately.\")\n\n # ---- 5 O&M -------------------------------------------------------------------------\n rb.heading(\"5. Operation and Maintenance Guidance\", 1)\n rb.paragraph(\n \"The lifetime of the borehole depends on routine care. The tasks \"\n \"below follow standard rural water supply practice; the community \"\n \"should keep a logbook of all maintenance, breakdowns and payments.\",\n align=\"justify\",\n )\n for period, tasks in _OM_GUIDANCE:\n rb.paragraph(period, bold=True)\n rb.bullets(tasks)\n yr = analysis.yield_recommendation if analysis else None\n if yr is not None and yr.safe_yield_m3_per_h:\n rb.paragraph(\n f\"Operate the pump at no more than {fmt_num(yr.safe_yield_m3_per_h)} \"\n \"m3/h and allow the recommended rest periods. If the water level \"\n \"reaches the pump intake, stop pumping and let the borehole recover.\",\n bold=True,\n )\n if inputs.tariff_note:\n rb.paragraph(f\"Tariff arrangement: {inputs.tariff_note}\")\n\n # ---- 6 committee -----------------------------------------------------------------\n rb.heading(\"6. Community / WASH Committee\", 1)\n if inputs.committee:\n rb.table(\n [[m.role, m.name, m.phone] for m in inputs.committee],\n header=[\"Role\", \"Name\", \"Phone\"],\n caption=\"WASH committee members responsible for the water point.\",\n )\n else:\n rb.paragraph(\n \"The WASH committee membership should be recorded here (chair, \"\n \"secretary, treasurer, caretakers) with contact numbers.\"\n )\n if inputs.committee_notes:\n rb.paragraph(inputs.committee_notes, align=\"justify\")\n\n # ---- 7 recommendations -----------------------------------------------------------\n rb.heading(\"7. Recommendations\", 1)\n recs = [\n \"Protect the wellhead: keep the 30 m sanitary zone free of latrines, \"\n \"refuse pits and animal pens.\",\n \"Keep this report and the borehole data sheet with the committee \"\n \"records; any future contractor will need them.\",\n \"Report persistent taste, odour or discolouration to the district \"\n \"water office and arrange a water quality test.\",\n ]\n state = inputs.quality.verdict_state if inputs.quality is not None else None\n if state in (\"health_fail\", \"national_fail\"):\n recs.insert(\n 0,\n \"Implement the treatment measures in the water quality report \"\n \"before the water is used for drinking.\",\n )\n elif state == \"indeterminate\":\n recs.insert(\n 0,\n \"Do not describe this supply as safe to drink until the water \"\n \"quality results are complete: \"\n + \"; \".join(inputs.quality.uncertainties)\n + \".\",\n )\n if (\n inputs.quality is not None\n and inputs.quality.corrosivity is not None\n and inputs.quality.corrosivity.is_aggressive\n ):\n recs.insert(0, inputs.quality.corrosivity.materials_note)\n recs.extend(inputs.extra_recommendations)\n rb.bullets(recs)\n\n # ---- references and glossary -----------------------------------------------\n rb.references(references_for(\"handover\"))\n rb.glossary(GLOSSARY)\n\n # ---- signatures ----------------------------------------------------------------------\n rb.heading(\"8. Handover Signatures\", 1)\n rb.paragraph(\n \"The works described above are handed over to the client and the \"\n \"community in working condition.\"\n )\n for role, name in (\n (\"For the contractor\", inputs.contractor_rep or site.contractor),\n (\"For the client\", inputs.client_rep or site.client),\n (\"For the community / WASH committee\", inputs.community_rep),\n ):\n rb.paragraph(\"\")\n rb.paragraph(\".\" * 30)\n rb.paragraph(f\"{role}: {name}\", bold=True)\n rb.paragraph(\"Date: ........................\")\n\n return rb.save(out_path)\n\n\ndef _executive_summary(inputs: HandoverReportInputs) -> tuple[list[str], list[str]]:\n \"\"\"Compose the handover executive summary from the assembled results.\"\"\"\n site = inputs.site\n community = site.community or \"the water point\"\n log = inputs.log\n analysis = inputs.pumping\n yr = analysis.yield_recommendation if analysis else None\n quality = inputs.quality\n\n bits = [\n f\"This report hands over the completed borehole water supply at \"\n f\"{community}\" + (f\", {site.district} District\" if site.district else \"\") + \".\"\n ]\n if log is not None and log.total_depth_m:\n s = f\"The borehole was drilled to {fmt_num(log.total_depth_m)} m\"\n if log.status:\n s += f\" and is recorded as {log.status.lower()}\"\n bits.append(s + \".\")\n if yr is not None and yr.safe_yield_m3_per_h:\n bits.append(\n f\"The recommended safe yield is {fmt_num(yr.safe_yield_m3_per_h)} m3/h.\"\n )\n if quality is not None:\n # Chosen on the full verdict state, not the health exceedances alone:\n # a national breach or an unevaluable panel used to read as suitable.\n sentence = SUITABILITY_SENTENCE[quality.verdict_state]\n if quality.verdict_state in (\"health_fail\", \"national_fail\"):\n sentence = sentence.rstrip(\".\") + \"; see the water quality section.\"\n bits.append(sentence)\n\n key: list[str] = []\n if log is not None and log.total_depth_m:\n key.append(\n f\"Borehole depth: {fmt_num(log.total_depth_m)} m\"\n + (f\", {log.status}.\" if log.status else \".\")\n )\n if yr is not None and yr.safe_yield_m3_per_h:\n key.append(f\"Safe yield: {fmt_num(yr.safe_yield_m3_per_h)} m3/h.\")\n if quality is not None:\n key.append(\"Water safety: \" + SUITABILITY_PHRASE[quality.verdict_state])\n key.append(\n \"Keep this report with the WASH committee records and maintain the \"\n \"sanitary protection zone around the wellhead.\"\n )\n return [\" \".join(bits)], key\n\n\ndef _default_works(inputs: HandoverReportInputs) -> list[str]:\n works = [\"Geophysical siting survey and borehole location selection.\"]\n if inputs.log is not None:\n works.append(\n f\"Drilling of the borehole to {fmt_num(inputs.log.total_depth_m)} m\"\n + (f\" by {inputs.log.drilling_method}\" if inputs.log.drilling_method else \"\")\n + \".\"\n )\n if inputs.design is not None:\n works.append(\n \"Construction with \"\n f\"{inputs.design.casing_diameter_in:g} inch {inputs.design.casing_material} \"\n \"casing and screens, gravel pack and sanitary seal.\"\n )\n works += [\n \"Development of the borehole by air lifting until clear.\",\n \"Pumping test and yield assessment.\",\n \"Water quality sampling and laboratory analysis.\",\n \"Wellhead completion with apron and drainage.\",\n ]\n return works\n"}, "groundwater/reporting/procurement.py": {"t": "text", "d": "\"\"\"The interim payment certificate.\n\nThe document a contractor is paid against, so everything that reduces the\npayment appears on its face with its own line: what was authorised, what was\nmeasured, what the difference is, and every deduction between the value of\nthe work and the figure at the bottom. A certificate that shows only the\nbottom figure is one nobody can check, and one nobody can check is one\nnobody can dispute.\n\nWhere the valuation found a problem it is printed before the money rather\nthan after it. The certificate is still issued - work has been done and the\ncontractor has to be paid for it - but the person signing sees first what\nthe figure below rests on.\n\"\"\"\n\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom dataclasses import dataclass\nfrom typing import Any\n\nfrom ..config import Config\nfrom ..procurement import Certificate, Contract, contract_summary\nfrom .docx_utils import ReportBuilder\n\n__all__ = [\"PaymentCertificateInputs\", \"build_payment_certificate\"]\n\n\n@dataclass\nclass PaymentCertificateInputs:\n contract: Contract\n certificate: Certificate\n prepared_by: str = \"\"\n prepared_role: str = \"Supervising engineer\"\n readiness: Any = None\n\n\ndef build_payment_certificate(inputs: PaymentCertificateInputs,\n out_path, config: Config | None = None):\n contract = inputs.contract\n certificate = inputs.certificate\n rb = ReportBuilder(config.style if config else None,\n title=f\"Interim Payment Certificate {certificate.number}\")\n\n rb.cover(\n [f\"Interim Payment Certificate No. {certificate.number}\"],\n [contract.ref, contract.contractor or \"\"],\n [(\"Date\", certificate.date),\n (\"Due on this certificate\", f\"${certificate.due_now_usd:,.0f}\")],\n )\n rb.provisional_stamp(inputs.readiness)\n\n if certificate.problems:\n rb.heading(\"Before the figures\")\n rb.paragraph(\n \"The valuation below could not be made cleanly. Each item here \"\n \"reduces or holds back money, and the certificate is issued with \"\n \"them showing rather than resolved silently.\", bold=True)\n rb.bullets(certificate.problems)\n\n rb.heading(\"Summary\")\n rb.table([[label, value] for label, value in\n contract_summary(contract, certificate)],\n header=[\"\", \"\"], col_widths_cm=[8.0, 7.0])\n if certificate.overpaid_usd:\n rb.paragraph(\n f\"Certificates already issued exceed the value of the work by \"\n f\"${certificate.overpaid_usd:,.0f}. Nothing is due on this \"\n \"certificate. Recovering the difference is a credit note to be \"\n \"agreed, not a negative payment.\", bold=True)\n\n rb.heading(\"Measurement\")\n rb.table(\n [[line.code, line.item, line.unit,\n f\"{line.contract_quantity:g}\",\n f\"{line.variation_quantity:+g}\" if line.variation_quantity else \"-\",\n f\"{line.measured_quantity:g}\",\n f\"{line.payable_quantity:g}\",\n f\"{line.rate_usd:,.2f}\",\n f\"{line.payable_amount_usd:,.0f}\"]\n for line in certificate.lines],\n header=[\"Code\", \"Item\", \"Unit\", \"Contract\", \"Varied\", \"Measured\",\n \"Payable\", \"Rate (USD)\", \"Amount (USD)\"],\n caption=\"Work measured to date and what is payable on it\",\n col_widths_cm=[1.6, 4.2, 1.2, 1.6, 1.4, 1.6, 1.5, 1.6, 1.8],\n font_size_pt=8.5,\n )\n\n overmeasured = [line for line in certificate.lines\n if line.overmeasure_quantity > 0]\n if overmeasured:\n rb.heading(\"Measured beyond what was authorised\")\n rb.paragraph(\n \"The quantities below have been done but not authorised, so they \"\n \"are not certified here. That is not a judgement on whether the \"\n \"work was necessary - it usually was - but on whether anybody has \"\n \"yet signed for it. A variation order authorising them makes them \"\n \"payable on the next certificate.\", align=\"justify\")\n rb.table(\n [[line.code, line.item,\n f\"{line.authorised_quantity:g} {line.unit}\",\n f\"{line.measured_quantity:g} {line.unit}\",\n f\"{line.overmeasure_quantity:g} {line.unit}\",\n f\"{line.overmeasure_amount_usd:,.0f}\"]\n for line in overmeasured],\n header=[\"Code\", \"Item\", \"Authorised\", \"Measured\", \"Excess\",\n \"Value withheld (USD)\"],\n col_widths_cm=[1.8, 4.6, 2.4, 2.4, 2.0, 2.4],\n )\n rb.paragraph(\n f\"Total value measured but not certified: \"\n f\"${certificate.overmeasure_usd:,.0f}.\", bold=True)\n\n varied = [line for line in certificate.lines if line.variation_refs]\n if varied:\n rb.heading(\"Variations included\")\n rb.table(\n [[\", \".join(line.variation_refs), line.code, line.item,\n f\"{line.variation_quantity:+g} {line.unit}\",\n f\"{line.authorised_amount_usd - line.contract_amount_usd:+,.0f}\"]\n for line in varied],\n header=[\"Reference\", \"Code\", \"Item\", \"Quantity\", \"Value (USD)\"],\n col_widths_cm=[2.4, 1.8, 5.6, 2.6, 3.2],\n )\n\n rb.heading(\"Certification\")\n rb.paragraph(\n f\"The work described above has been measured and valued at \"\n f\"${certificate.gross_usd:,.0f}. After retention and previous \"\n f\"certificates, ${certificate.due_now_usd:,.0f} is due to \"\n f\"{contract.contractor or 'the contractor'} on this certificate.\")\n rb.signature_block(\n name=inputs.prepared_by, role=inputs.prepared_role,\n organisation=(config.style.organisation if config else \"\"),\n )\n return rb.save(out_path)\n"}, "groundwater/reporting/pumping.py": {"t": "text", "d": "\"\"\"Pumping test report generator.\n\nCovers the test details, data quality notes, diagnostic plots, the\naquifer parameters from every applicable method, and the safe yield\nrecommendation with its full basis. When discharge is missing the\nreport still carries the drawdown and recovery curves, the stabilised\nlevel and available drawdown, with transmissivity and yield stated as\npending.\n\"\"\"\n\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom typing import Any\n\nfrom dataclasses import dataclass\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nimport numpy as np\n\nfrom ..config import Config\nfrom ..hydraulics.analysis import PumpingTestAnalysis\nfrom ..hydraulics.plots import (\n plot_cooper_jacob,\n plot_recovery,\n plot_step_test,\n plot_test_overview,\n plot_theis,\n)\nfrom ..seasonal import MONTH_NAMES\nfrom ..utils import fmt_num, safe_slug\nfrom .citations import GLOSSARY, references_for\nfrom .docx_utils import ReportBuilder\n\n\n@dataclass\nclass PumpingReportInputs:\n analysis: PumpingTestAnalysis\n figures_dir: Path\n analyst_name: str = \"\"\n analyst_role: str = \"Hydrogeologist\"\n analyst_phone: str = \"\"\n include_qa_section: bool = True\n #: The certification gate for this report, from\n #: :func:`groundwater.readiness.assess_readiness`. When it is not\n #: certifiable the cover says so; when it is absent nothing is\n #: stamped, so an existing caller is unaffected.\n readiness: Any = None\n #: The seasonal projection from :func:`groundwater.seasonal.seasonal_yield`.\n #: Absent, section 5 reports the single figure as before.\n seasonal: Any = None\n\n\ndef _executive_summary(analysis: PumpingTestAnalysis) -> tuple[list[str], list[str]]:\n \"\"\"Compose the pumping-test executive summary from the analysis.\"\"\"\n test = analysis.test\n community = test.site.community or \"the site\"\n test_name = test.test_type.replace(\"+\", \" with \")\n yr = analysis.yield_recommendation\n t = analysis.transmissivity_m2_per_day\n if yr is not None and yr.safe_yield_m3_per_h:\n para = (\n f\"A {test_name} pumping test was carried out on the borehole at \"\n f\"{community}. The recommended safe yield is \"\n f\"{fmt_num(yr.safe_yield_m3_per_h)} m3/h (safety factor \"\n f\"{yr.safety_factor:g} applied to the long term yield), with the \"\n f\"pump intake set at {fmt_num(yr.pump_installation_depth_m)} m \"\n \"below ground level.\"\n )\n key = [\n f\"Transmissivity: {fmt_num(t)} m2/day.\" if t else \"\",\n f\"Recommended safe yield: {yr.yield_range_text}.\",\n f\"Pump installation depth: {fmt_num(yr.pump_installation_depth_m)} m.\",\n \"Operate within the recommended rate and monitor the pumping level.\",\n ]\n else:\n reason = (yr.pending_reason if yr and yr.pending_reason\n else \"the discharge is not recorded\")\n para = (\n f\"A {test_name} pumping test was carried out on the borehole at \"\n f\"{community}. The drawdown and recovery curves are valid, but the \"\n \"transmissivity and safe yield are pending because \" + reason + \".\"\n )\n key = [\n f\"Stabilised water level: {fmt_num(analysis.stabilised_level_m)} m.\"\n if analysis.stabilised_level_m is not None else \"\",\n f\"Yield recommendation pending: {reason}.\",\n ]\n return [para], key\n\n\ndef build_pumping_report(\n inputs: PumpingReportInputs,\n out_path: str | Path,\n config: Config | None = None,\n) -> Path:\n config = config or Config()\n analysis = inputs.analysis\n test = analysis.test\n site = test.site\n figures = Path(inputs.figures_dir)\n # Qualify figure filenames with the borehole: several reports share one\n # figures directory in an app session, and generation is guarded by an\n # existence check, so fixed names made the second report silently embed\n # the first borehole's curves.\n slug = safe_slug(test.borehole_ref or test.site.community, \"bh\")\n figures.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)\n\n rb = ReportBuilder(config.style, title=f\"Pumping Test Report - {site.community}\")\n rb.cover(\n title_lines=[\"PUMPING TEST REPORT\"],\n subtitle_lines=[\n f\"{test.test_type.replace('+', ' with ').title()} Test\",\n f\"at {site.community}\" + (f\", {site.district} District\" if site.district else \"\"),\n ],\n details=[\n (\"Client\", site.client),\n (\"Borehole\", test.borehole_ref or \"n/a\"),\n (\"Test date\", site.date),\n (\"Conducted by\", site.supervisor),\n ],\n )\n rb.provisional_stamp(inputs.readiness)\n\n # ---- executive summary ------------------------------------------------\n exec_paras, exec_key = _executive_summary(analysis)\n rb.executive_summary(exec_paras, exec_key)\n\n # ---- 1 test details ---------------------------------------------------\n rb.heading(\"1. Test Details\", 1)\n rb.header_block_table(\n [\n (\"Community\", site.community), (\"Client\", site.client),\n (\"Borehole Ref. No.\", test.borehole_ref or \"\"), (\"Date\", site.date),\n (\"Test type\", test.test_type), (\"Conducted by\", site.supervisor),\n (\"Depth of borehole\", fmt_num(test.borehole_depth_m) + \" m\" if test.borehole_depth_m else \"\"),\n (\"Static water level\", fmt_num(test.static_water_level_m) + \" m\" if test.static_water_level_m is not None else \"\"),\n (\"Pump setting\", fmt_num(test.pump_setting_m) + \" m\" if test.pump_setting_m else \"\"),\n (\"Length of each step\", fmt_num(test.step_length_min) + \" min\" if test.step_length_min else \"\"),\n ]\n )\n discharges = \", \".join(\n f\"{s.label}: \" + (f\"{s.discharge_m3_per_h:g} m3/h\" if s.discharge_m3_per_h else \"not recorded\")\n for s in test.steps\n )\n rb.paragraph(f\"Discharge rates: {discharges}.\")\n if not test.has_discharge:\n rb.paragraph(\n \"The discharge rate was not recorded on the field sheet. The \"\n \"drawdown and recovery curves below remain valid; transmissivity \"\n \"and yield results are pending until the discharge is supplied.\",\n bold=True,\n )\n\n # ---- 2 data ------------------------------------------------------------\n rb.heading(\"2. Field Data\", 1)\n rb.paragraph(\n \"True drawdown is computed as the measured water level minus the \"\n \"static water level. The drawdown column recorded on the field sheet \"\n \"holds the increment between successive readings and is not used \"\n \"directly. Reading intervals are irregular and are handled as \"\n \"recorded.\",\n align=\"justify\",\n )\n overview_path = figures / f\"test_overview_{slug}.png\"\n if not overview_path.exists():\n plot_test_overview(test, path=overview_path, style=config.style)\n fig_no = rb.figure(overview_path, \"Water level record for the full test including recovery.\")\n if analysis.stabilised_level_m is not None:\n rb.paragraph(\n f\"The pumped water level stabilised at about \"\n f\"{fmt_num(analysis.stabilised_level_m)} m (Figure {fig_no}).\"\n )\n if analysis.max_drawdown_m is not None:\n rb.paragraph(\n f\"The maximum drawdown reached {fmt_num(analysis.max_drawdown_m)} m \"\n \"below the static water level.\"\n )\n if inputs.include_qa_section and analysis.flags:\n rb.paragraph(\"Data verification notes:\", bold=True)\n rb.bullets([str(f) for f in analysis.flags])\n\n # ---- 3 analysis ----------------------------------------------------------\n rb.heading(\"3. Analysis\", 1)\n swl = test.static_water_level_m\n section = 0\n\n if analysis.cooper_jacob is not None:\n section += 1\n cj = analysis.cooper_jacob\n rb.heading(f\"3.{section} Cooper-Jacob straight line method\", 2)\n step = test.steps[0]\n t = step.time_min\n s = step.water_level_m - swl\n cj_path = figures / f\"cooper_jacob_{slug}.png\"\n if not cj_path.exists():\n plot_cooper_jacob(t, s, cj, path=cj_path, style=config.style)\n rb.figure(cj_path, \"Drawdown against log time with the fitted straight line.\")\n rb.paragraph(\n f\"The late time slope is {fmt_num(cj.slope_m_per_log_cycle)} m per \"\n f\"log cycle over {cj.n_points} readings \"\n f\"(R squared {cj.r_squared:.3f}), giving a transmissivity of \"\n f\"{fmt_num(cj.transmissivity_m2_per_day)} m2/day at a discharge of \"\n f\"{fmt_num(cj.discharge_m3_per_h)} m3/h. {cj.u_check}.\",\n align=\"justify\",\n )\n if cj.storativity is not None:\n rb.paragraph(\n f\"Storativity from the zero drawdown intercept: \"\n f\"{cj.storativity:.2e} (observation well data).\"\n )\n\n if analysis.theis is not None:\n section += 1\n th = analysis.theis\n rb.heading(f\"3.{section} Theis type curve fit\", 2)\n step = test.steps[0]\n theis_path = figures / f\"theis_fit_{slug}.png\"\n if not theis_path.exists():\n plot_theis(step.time_min, step.water_level_m - swl, th, path=theis_path, style=config.style)\n rb.figure(theis_path, \"Log-log drawdown with the fitted Theis curve.\")\n s_note = \"\" if th.storativity_reliable else (\n \" In a single pumped well storativity trades off against the \"\n \"effective well radius, so the fitted S is indicative only.\"\n )\n rb.paragraph(\n f\"Least squares fitting of the Theis well function gives \"\n f\"T = {fmt_num(th.transmissivity_m2_per_day)} m2/day and \"\n f\"S = {th.storativity:.1e} (RMSE {fmt_num(th.rmse_m)} m).{s_note}\",\n align=\"justify\",\n )\n\n if analysis.recovery is not None:\n section += 1\n rec = analysis.recovery\n rb.heading(f\"3.{section} Theis recovery method\", 2)\n rec_path = figures / f\"recovery_{slug}.png\"\n if not rec_path.exists():\n plot_recovery(\n test.recovery_time_min, test.residual_drawdown(),\n test.pumping_duration_min, rec, path=rec_path, style=config.style,\n )\n rb.figure(rec_path, \"Residual drawdown against t/t'.\")\n rb.paragraph(\n f\"The recovery slope is {fmt_num(rec.slope_m_per_log_cycle)} m per \"\n f\"log cycle (R squared {rec.r_squared:.3f}), giving \"\n f\"T = {fmt_num(rec.transmissivity_m2_per_day)} m2/day. Residual \"\n f\"drawdown at the end of monitoring was {fmt_num(rec.residual_at_end_m)} m. \"\n \"Recovery derived transmissivity is generally the most reliable \"\n \"single well estimate because it is unaffected by pumping rate \"\n \"fluctuations and well losses.\",\n align=\"justify\",\n )\n\n if analysis.step_test is not None:\n section += 1\n st = analysis.step_test\n rb.heading(f\"3.{section} Step drawdown analysis (Hantush-Bierschenk)\", 2)\n st_path = figures / f\"step_test_{slug}.png\"\n if not st_path.exists():\n plot_step_test(test, st, path=st_path, style=config.style)\n rb.figure(st_path, \"Step drawdown data and the specific drawdown fit.\")\n rows = [\n [s[\"step\"], fmt_num(s[\"discharge_m3_per_h\"]), fmt_num(s[\"drawdown_end_m\"]),\n fmt_num(s[\"sw_over_q_day_per_m2\"], 3), f\"{s['efficiency_percent']:.0f}%\"]\n for s in st.steps\n ]\n rb.table(\n rows,\n header=[\"Step\", \"Q (m3/h)\", \"End drawdown (m)\", \"s/Q (day/m2)\", \"Efficiency\"],\n caption=\"Step test summary and well efficiency.\",\n )\n rb.paragraph(\n f\"The drawdown-discharge relationship is s = BQ + CQ2 with \"\n f\"B = {st.aquifer_loss_B:.3e} day/m2 (aquifer loss) and \"\n f\"C = {st.well_loss_C:.3e} day2/m5 (well loss), fitted with \"\n f\"R squared {st.r_squared:.3f}.\",\n align=\"justify\",\n )\n elif test.test_type.startswith(\"step\") and not test.has_discharge:\n section += 1\n rb.heading(f\"3.{section} Step drawdown analysis\", 2)\n step_path = figures / f\"step_test_{slug}.png\"\n if not step_path.exists():\n plot_step_test(test, None, path=step_path, style=config.style)\n rb.figure(step_path, \"Step drawdown curves (discharge pending).\")\n rb.paragraph(\n \"Hantush-Bierschenk analysis is pending until the discharge of \"\n \"each step is supplied.\",\n )\n\n # ---- 4 results summary ------------------------------------------------\n rb.heading(\"4. Results Summary\", 1)\n rows = []\n if analysis.cooper_jacob:\n rows.append([\"Cooper-Jacob\", fmt_num(analysis.cooper_jacob.transmissivity_m2_per_day)])\n if analysis.theis:\n rows.append([\"Theis curve fit\", fmt_num(analysis.theis.transmissivity_m2_per_day)])\n if analysis.recovery:\n rows.append([\"Theis recovery\", fmt_num(analysis.recovery.transmissivity_m2_per_day)])\n if rows:\n rb.table(rows, header=[\"Method\", \"Transmissivity (m2/day)\"],\n caption=\"Transmissivity estimates.\")\n else:\n rb.paragraph(\"Transmissivity: pending (discharge not recorded).\", bold=True)\n yr = analysis.yield_recommendation\n if yr is not None:\n summary_rows = [\n [\"Specific capacity\", fmt_num(yr.specific_capacity_m3hr_per_m) + \" m3/h per m\"\n if yr.specific_capacity_m3hr_per_m else \"pending\"],\n [\"Available drawdown\", fmt_num(yr.available_drawdown_m) + \" m\"\n if yr.available_drawdown_m else \"n/a\"],\n [\"Usable drawdown\", fmt_num(yr.usable_drawdown_m) + \" m\"\n if yr.usable_drawdown_m else \"n/a\"],\n [\"Long term yield\", fmt_num(yr.long_term_yield_m3_per_h) + \" m3/h\"\n if yr.long_term_yield_m3_per_h else \"pending\"],\n [f\"Recommended safe yield (safety factor {yr.safety_factor:g})\",\n yr.yield_range_text],\n [\"Recommended pump installation depth\",\n fmt_num(yr.pump_installation_depth_m) + \" m\" if yr.pump_installation_depth_m else \"pending\"],\n ]\n rb.table(summary_rows, header=[\"Quantity\", \"Value\"], caption=\"Yield summary.\")\n\n # ---- 5 recommendation ----------------------------------------------------\n rb.heading(\"5. Yield Recommendation\", 1)\n if yr is not None:\n rb.paragraph(yr.basis, align=\"justify\")\n if yr.envelope_basis:\n rb.paragraph(yr.envelope_basis, align=\"justify\")\n if yr.safe_yield_m3_per_h:\n rb.bullets(\n [\n f\"Operate the borehole at no more than \"\n f\"{fmt_num(yr.safe_yield_m3_per_h)} m3/h.\",\n f\"Install the pump intake at {fmt_num(yr.pump_installation_depth_m)} m \"\n \"below ground level.\",\n \"Monitor the pumping water level and re-assess the yield if \"\n \"the level approaches the pump intake.\",\n ]\n )\n\n seasonal = inputs.seasonal\n if seasonal is not None and seasonal.is_established:\n rb.heading(\"5.1 Through the year\", 2)\n rb.paragraph(\n \"A pumping test measures one day. The borehole has to supply the \"\n \"village on the worst day, and those are months apart: the water \"\n \"table is recharged through the single wet season, peaks at the \"\n \"end of it and falls through the dry season to an annual low in \"\n \"April or May. The same test therefore means different things \"\n \"depending on when it was run, so the yield is reported here at \"\n \"each of three water levels rather than at one.\",\n align=\"justify\")\n if seasonal.month:\n rb.paragraph(\n f\"This test was run in {MONTH_NAMES[seasonal.month - 1]}, the \"\n f\"{seasonal.season}.\")\n elif seasonal.month_note:\n rb.paragraph(\n seasonal.month_note + \" The whole annual range is therefore \"\n \"reserved, which is the conservative reading.\", bold=True)\n rb.table(\n [[s.title, f\"{s.decline_m:.1f}\",\n fmt_num(s.static_water_level_m), fmt_num(s.available_drawdown_m),\n fmt_num(s.safe_yield_m3_per_h),\n fmt_num(s.pump_installation_depth_m)]\n for s in seasonal.scenarios],\n header=[\"Scenario\", \"Further decline (m)\", \"Static level (m)\",\n \"Available drawdown (m)\", \"Safe yield (m3/h)\",\n \"Pump intake (m)\"],\n caption=\"Safe yield and pump setting at each seasonal water level\",\n )\n rb.paragraph(\n f\"The annual range used is {seasonal.annual_range_m:.1f} m - \"\n f\"{seasonal.range_source}. It is the one number here that a single \"\n \"test cannot measure, and every figure in the table moves with it.\",\n italic=True)\n loss = seasonal.dry_season_loss_percent\n if loss and loss > 1:\n rb.paragraph(\n f\"By the end of the dry season the borehole yields about \"\n f\"{loss:.0f}% less than it did on the day of the test.\",\n bold=True)\n rb.bullets([s.note for s in seasonal.scenarios])\n if seasonal.pump_installation_depth_m is not None:\n rb.paragraph(\n \"Set the pump intake at \"\n f\"{fmt_num(seasonal.pump_installation_depth_m)} m below ground \"\n \"level: deep enough for the drought case, because the pump is \"\n \"fitted once and a pump that draws air in a bad year loses the \"\n \"village its borehole in the year it is needed most.\",\n bold=True)\n\n # ---- limitations -----------------------------------------------------------\n rb.heading(\"6. Limitations and Uncertainty\", 1)\n rb.bullets(\n [\n \"The analysis assumes a homogeneous, isotropic aquifer of large \"\n \"extent. A barrier or a recharge (stream or coast) boundary, if \"\n \"present, changes the late-time drawdown slope and would bias the \"\n \"transmissivity.\",\n \"In a single pumped well the storativity trades off against the \"\n \"effective well radius, so any storativity reported from this test \"\n \"is indicative only.\",\n \"The safe yield is projected to the design period from a short \"\n \"test; it should be confirmed by monitoring the pumping water \"\n \"level once the borehole is in service.\",\n \"Yield varies with the season. Section 5.1 projects the tested \"\n \"level to the annual low and to a drought year, but the size of \"\n \"the annual swing is assumed rather than measured; two water-level \"\n \"readings a year apart in this borehole would replace that \"\n \"assumption with a number.\",\n ]\n )\n\n # ---- references and glossary -----------------------------------------------\n rb.references(references_for(\"pumping\"))\n rb.glossary(GLOSSARY)\n\n rb.signature_block(\n name=inputs.analyst_name or site.supervisor,\n role=inputs.analyst_role,\n phone=inputs.analyst_phone,\n organisation=config.style.organisation,\n )\n return rb.save(out_path)\n"}, "groundwater/reporting/quality.py": {"t": "text", "d": "\"\"\"Water quality report generator.\n\nPresents the laboratory results against WHO guideline values and the\nnational standard, flags every exceedance clearly (bold red status),\nreports the ionic balance check and, where the major ions are\navailable, the Piper and Stiff diagrams, and closes with treatment\nrecommendations matched to the exceedances found.\n\"\"\"\n\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom typing import Any\n\nfrom dataclasses import dataclass\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nfrom docx.shared import Pt, RGBColor\n\nfrom ..config import Config\nfrom ..quality.assess import STATUS_LABELS, WaterQualityAssessment\nfrom ..quality.diagrams import plot_piper, plot_stiff\nfrom ..quality.standards import (\n PROVISIONAL_NATIONAL_NOTE,\n provisional_national_parameters,\n)\nfrom ..utils import fmt_num, safe_slug\nfrom .citations import GLOSSARY, references_for\nfrom .docx_utils import ReportBuilder\n\n#: The wording lives with the assessment so every surface prints the same\n#: label and a new status can never leak out as a raw code.\n_STATUS_LABEL = STATUS_LABELS\n\ndef _sentence(text: str) -> str:\n \"\"\"Upper-case the first letter only.\n\n str.capitalize() lower-cases everything after it, which turns \"E. coli\"\n into \"e. coli\" and \"Total petroleum hydrocarbons\" into a lower-case\n determinand halfway through a client-facing sentence.\n \"\"\"\n return text[:1].upper() + text[1:] if text else text\n\n\n_TREATMENT_ADVICE = {\n \"iron\": \"Iron above the acceptability value causes staining and metallic \"\n \"taste; aeration followed by sand filtration or a simple oxidation \"\n \"filter normally resolves it.\",\n \"manganese\": \"Manganese requires oxidation and filtration (aeration or \"\n \"chlorination followed by filtration); monitor infant exposure in the \"\n \"meantime.\",\n \"e. coli\": \"Any E. coli detection calls for shock chlorination of the \"\n \"borehole, verification of the sanitary seal and apron, and re-sampling \"\n \"before use.\",\n \"total coliforms\": \"Coliform detection calls for disinfection of the \"\n \"borehole and pump, a sanitary inspection of the wellhead, and re-sampling.\",\n \"nitrate (as no3)\": \"Elevated nitrate usually indicates pollution from \"\n \"sanitation or agriculture; investigate the sanitary protection zone. Do \"\n \"not give the water to bottle fed infants until resolved.\",\n \"fluoride\": \"Fluoride above 1.5 mg/L requires an alternative source or \"\n \"defluoridation (bone char or activated alumina).\",\n \"arsenic\": \"Arsenic above 0.01 mg/L requires an alternative source or \"\n \"specialised removal; re-test to confirm before any use for drinking.\",\n \"ph\": \"Low pH water is corrosive to metal fittings; a limestone contactor \"\n \"or careful choice of corrosion resistant materials is advised.\",\n \"turbidity\": \"High turbidity interferes with disinfection; extend \"\n \"development of the borehole and re-sample.\",\n}\n\n\n@dataclass\nclass QualityReportInputs:\n assessment: WaterQualityAssessment\n figures_dir: Path\n analyst_name: str = \"\"\n analyst_role: str = \"Water Quality Analyst\"\n analyst_phone: str = \"\"\n include_diagrams: bool = True\n #: The certification gate for this report, from\n #: :func:`groundwater.readiness.assess_readiness`. When it is not\n #: certifiable the cover says so; when it is absent nothing is\n #: stamped, so an existing caller is unaffected.\n readiness: Any = None\n\n\ndef _executive_summary(assessment: WaterQualityAssessment) -> tuple[list[str], list[str]]:\n \"\"\"Compose the water-quality executive summary from the assessment.\"\"\"\n community = assessment.sample.site.community or \"the site\"\n health = assessment.health_exceedances\n national = assessment.national_exceedances\n aesthetic = assessment.aesthetic_exceedances\n state = assessment.verdict_state\n if state == \"national_fail\":\n names = \", \".join(r.parameter for r in national)\n para = (\n f\"Laboratory results for the borehole water at {community} meet the \"\n \"WHO health based guideline values but do not comply with the \"\n f\"national standard limit(s) for {names}. A national limit is a \"\n \"legal requirement, not a matter of taste: treatment is required \"\n \"before the supply can be accepted.\"\n )\n key = [\n \"All WHO health based guideline values are met.\",\n f\"National standard exceedance(s): {names}.\",\n \"Treatment is required before the supply is accepted.\",\n ]\n elif state == \"indeterminate\":\n para = (\n f\"Laboratory results for the borehole water at {community} do not \"\n \"establish that the water is suitable for drinking. \"\n + _sentence(\"; \".join(assessment.uncertainties))\n + \". No suitability verdict can be given until these are resolved.\"\n )\n key = [\n \"The water has NOT been shown to be safe to drink.\",\n ] + [_sentence(u) + \".\" for u in assessment.uncertainties]\n elif health:\n names = \", \".join(r.parameter for r in health)\n para = (\n f\"Laboratory results for the borehole water at {community} were \"\n \"assessed against the WHO Guidelines for Drinking-water Quality and \"\n \"the national/adopted limits. The water does not meet the health \"\n f\"based guideline value(s) for {names}, so treatment or an \"\n \"alternative source is required before it is used for drinking.\"\n )\n key = [\n f\"Health based exceedance(s): {names}.\",\n \"Treatment or an alternative source is required before drinking.\",\n ]\n elif aesthetic:\n names = \", \".join(r.parameter for r in aesthetic)\n para = (\n f\"Laboratory results for the borehole water at {community} meet all \"\n \"health based guideline values. Acceptability (aesthetic) limits are \"\n f\"exceeded for {names}; the water is usable for drinking, although \"\n \"taste, odour or staining complaints may arise.\"\n )\n key = [\n \"All health based guideline values are met.\",\n f\"Aesthetic exceedance(s): {names}.\",\n ]\n else:\n para = (\n f\"Laboratory results for the borehole water at {community} comply \"\n \"with the WHO guideline values and the national/adopted limits \"\n \"applied. The water is suitable for drinking on the basis of the \"\n \"parameters tested.\"\n )\n key = [\n \"All measured parameters comply with the limits applied.\",\n \"The water is suitable for drinking on the parameters tested.\",\n ]\n return [para], key\n\n\ndef build_quality_report(\n inputs: QualityReportInputs,\n out_path: str | Path,\n config: Config | None = None,\n) -> Path:\n config = config or Config()\n assessment = inputs.assessment\n sample = assessment.sample\n site = sample.site\n figures = Path(inputs.figures_dir)\n figures.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)\n # Qualify figure filenames with the site: several reports share one\n # figures directory in an app session and generation is guarded by an\n # existence check, so fixed names made the second report silently reuse\n # the first site's figures.\n slug = safe_slug(sample.borehole_ref or site.community, \"site\")\n\n rb = ReportBuilder(config.style, title=f\"Water Quality Report - {site.community}\")\n rb.cover(\n title_lines=[\"WATER QUALITY REPORT\"],\n subtitle_lines=[\n f\"Borehole water assessment at {site.community}\"\n + (f\", {site.district} District\" if site.district else \"\"),\n ],\n details=[\n (\"Client\", site.client),\n (\"Sample ID\", sample.sample_id),\n (\"Borehole\", sample.borehole_ref),\n (\"Sample date\", sample.sample_date),\n (\"Laboratory\", sample.laboratory),\n ],\n )\n rb.provisional_stamp(inputs.readiness)\n\n # ---- executive summary ------------------------------------------------\n exec_paras, exec_key = _executive_summary(assessment)\n rb.executive_summary(exec_paras, exec_key)\n\n # ---- 1 sample details -------------------------------------------------\n rb.heading(\"1. Sample Details\", 1)\n rb.header_block_table(\n [\n (\"Community\", site.community), (\"Client\", site.client),\n (\"Sample ID\", sample.sample_id), (\"Borehole Ref. No.\", sample.borehole_ref),\n (\"Sample date\", sample.sample_date), (\"Laboratory\", sample.laboratory),\n (\"District\", site.district), (\"Project\", site.project),\n ]\n )\n rb.paragraph(\n \"Results are compared against the WHO Guidelines for Drinking-water \"\n \"Quality (fourth edition with addenda) and the national standard \"\n \"limits configured for this project. Where a confirmed national \"\n \"value is not available, the WHO or regional figure is adopted for \"\n \"that parameter and the status column reads national/adopted limit. \"\n \"Values reported by the laboratory as below the detection limit are \"\n \"shown as such.\",\n align=\"justify\",\n )\n # A national exceedance reads as a compliance failure, so the report must\n # say plainly when the limit it was judged against is not yet confirmed.\n if provisional_national_parameters():\n rb.paragraph(PROVISIONAL_NATIONAL_NOTE, align=\"justify\")\n\n # ---- 2 results table ------------------------------------------------------\n rb.heading(\"2. Results Against Guideline Values\", 1)\n table_no = rb.next_table_number\n rb.paragraph(\n f\"Table {table_no} lists every parameter tested. Exceedances are \"\n \"highlighted in the status column.\"\n )\n header = [\"Parameter\", \"Value\", \"Unit\", \"WHO health\", \"WHO acceptability\",\n \"National\", \"Status\"]\n rows = []\n highlight = []\n for r in assessment.rows:\n value = \"< DL\" if (r.below_detection and r.value is None) else fmt_num(r.value)\n rows.append([\n r.parameter, value, r.unit, r.who_health, r.who_aesthetic,\n r.sl_standard, _STATUS_LABEL.get(r.status, r.status),\n ])\n highlight.append(r.status in (\"exceeds_health\", \"exceeds_national\", \"exceeds_aesthetic\"))\n rb.table(rows, header=header, caption=\"Laboratory results against guideline values.\",\n font_size_pt=8.5)\n # bold red status text on exceedance rows\n table = rb.doc.tables[-1]\n for i, is_exceed in enumerate(highlight):\n if not is_exceed:\n continue\n cell = table.rows[i + 1].cells[len(header) - 1]\n for para in cell.paragraphs:\n for run in para.runs:\n run.font.bold = True\n run.font.color.rgb = RGBColor(0xB0, 0x00, 0x00)\n\n rb.paragraph(assessment.verdict, bold=True, align=\"justify\")\n\n # headline aggregate scores for quick ranking of the source\n wqi = assessment.wqi\n if wqi is not None:\n rb.paragraph(\n f\"Water Quality Index: {wqi.value:.0f} ({wqi.rating}), over \"\n f\"{wqi.n_parameters} physico-chemical parameters.\",\n bold=True,\n )\n hr = assessment.health_risk\n if hr is not None:\n line = f\"Health Hazard Index: {hr.hazard_index:.2f} ({hr.rating}).\"\n if hr.cancer_risk is not None:\n line += (\n f\" Estimated lifetime arsenic cancer risk {hr.cancer_risk:.1e}.\"\n )\n rb.paragraph(line, bold=True)\n\n # ---- 3 ionic balance ---------------------------------------------------------\n rb.heading(\"3. Ionic Balance Check\", 1)\n ionic = assessment.ionic\n if ionic is None:\n rb.paragraph(\n \"The major ion analysis is incomplete, so no ionic balance check \"\n \"is possible for this sample.\"\n )\n else:\n note = (\n \" Bicarbonate was estimated from total alkalinity.\"\n if ionic.used_alkalinity_for_bicarbonate\n else \"\"\n )\n rb.paragraph(\n f\"Sum of cations {fmt_num(ionic.sum_cations_meq, 3)} meq/L, sum of \"\n f\"anions {fmt_num(ionic.sum_anions_meq, 3)} meq/L, charge balance \"\n f\"error {ionic.error_percent:+.1f} percent.{note} \"\n + (\n \"The analysis balances within the normal 5 percent tolerance.\"\n if abs(ionic.error_percent) <= 5\n else \"The balance error exceeds 5 percent; the laboratory \"\n \"analysis should be reviewed.\"\n ),\n align=\"justify\",\n )\n\n # ---- 4 corrosivity and materials ---------------------------------------------\n rb.heading(\"4. Corrosivity and Materials\", 1)\n corr = assessment.corrosivity\n if corr is None or corr.classification == \"Insufficient data\":\n rb.paragraph(\n corr.verdict if corr is not None else\n \"Corrosivity was not assessed; pH, calcium and alkalinity are \"\n \"required to compute the saturation indices.\"\n )\n else:\n rb.paragraph(corr.verdict, align=\"justify\")\n idx_rows: list[list[str]] = []\n if corr.lsi is not None:\n idx_rows.append([\"Langelier Saturation Index (LSI)\", f\"{corr.lsi:+.2f}\"])\n if corr.rsi is not None:\n idx_rows.append([\"Ryznar Stability Index (RSI)\", f\"{corr.rsi:.2f}\"])\n if corr.aggressive_index is not None:\n idx_rows.append([\"Aggressive Index (AI)\", f\"{corr.aggressive_index:.2f}\"])\n if corr.larson_skold is not None:\n idx_rows.append([\"Larson-Skold ratio\", f\"{corr.larson_skold:.2f}\"])\n idx_rows.append([\"Classification\", corr.classification])\n rb.table(idx_rows, header=[\"Index\", \"Value\"],\n caption=\"Corrosivity and scaling indices.\")\n rb.paragraph(corr.materials_note, align=\"justify\", bold=corr.is_aggressive)\n if corr.assumptions:\n rb.paragraph(\"Assumptions: \" + \" \".join(corr.assumptions))\n\n # ---- 5 diagrams ----------------------------------------------------------------\n if inputs.include_diagrams and ionic is not None:\n rb.heading(\"5. Hydrochemical Facies\", 1)\n piper_path = figures / f\"piper_{slug}.png\"\n stiff_path = figures / f\"stiff_{slug}.png\"\n if not piper_path.exists():\n plot_piper([sample], path=piper_path, style=config.style)\n if not stiff_path.exists():\n plot_stiff(sample, path=stiff_path, style=config.style)\n rb.figure(piper_path, \"Piper diagram.\", width_cm=13.0)\n rb.figure(stiff_path, \"Stiff diagram.\", width_cm=11.0)\n\n # ---- 6 recommendations -----------------------------------------------------------\n rb.heading(\"6. Recommendations\", 1)\n advice = []\n if corr is not None and corr.is_aggressive:\n advice.append(corr.materials_note)\n for r in assessment.all_exceedances:\n key = r.parameter.strip().lower()\n for match, text in _TREATMENT_ADVICE.items():\n if match in key:\n advice.append(text)\n break\n if assessment.verdict_state == \"indeterminate\":\n # \"No treatment is required\" is a clearance, and this report has not\n # established one. Say what is outstanding instead.\n advice.append(\n \"Do not treat this supply as safe to drink on these results. \"\n + _sentence(\"; \".join(assessment.uncertainties))\n + \". Resolve these and re-issue the assessment before any \"\n \"treatment decision is taken.\"\n )\n elif not advice:\n advice.append(\n \"No treatment is required on the basis of the parameters tested. \"\n \"Maintain the sanitary seal and apron in good condition.\"\n )\n advice.append(\n \"Repeat physico-chemical and bacteriological testing at least once a \"\n \"year, and after any flooding or repair work on the wellhead.\"\n )\n rb.bullets(advice)\n\n # ---- 7 limitations ---------------------------------------------------------\n rb.heading(\"7. Limitations and Uncertainty\", 1)\n rb.bullets(\n [\n \"The results describe a single sample at one point in time. Water \"\n \"quality varies with the season, rainfall and the condition of the \"\n \"wellhead, so periodic re-testing is needed to confirm the \"\n \"verdict.\",\n \"Parameters reported below the laboratory detection limit are shown \"\n \"as such; a non-detection does not prove complete absence.\",\n \"The corrosivity and index calculations use the parameters \"\n \"supplied. Missing pH, calcium or alkalinity limit what can be \"\n \"assessed, and any assumptions made are stated where they are \"\n \"used.\",\n ]\n )\n\n # ---- references and glossary -----------------------------------------------\n rb.references(references_for(\"quality\"))\n rb.glossary(GLOSSARY)\n\n rb.signature_block(\n name=inputs.analyst_name,\n role=inputs.analyst_role,\n phone=inputs.analyst_phone,\n organisation=config.style.organisation,\n )\n return rb.save(out_path)\n"}, "groundwater/reporting/registry.py": {"t": "text", "d": "\"\"\"The asset record: what stays with the borehole after the project ends.\n\nTwo documents in one file, because they are two halves of the same job.\n\nThe **placard** is a single page meant to be printed, laminated and fixed\nto the headworks. It carries the identifier in large type, the QR symbol\nthat encodes it, and the handful of facts a technician needs before opening\nanything: where it is, how deep, what pump. Nothing on it goes out of date,\nwhich is why the maintenance history is deliberately not on it.\n\nThe **asset record** is the history: what has happened, what condition that\nleaves the borehole in, and what is now overdue. It is the document a\ndistrict water office reads when deciding where to send a repair team, and\nit says plainly when the answer is that nobody knows.\n\"\"\"\n\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom dataclasses import dataclass\nfrom datetime import date\nfrom pathlib import Path\nfrom typing import Any\n\nfrom docx.shared import Pt\n\nfrom .. import qr\nfrom ..config import Config\nfrom ..registry import (\n Asset,\n AssetState,\n Schedule,\n asset_state,\n placard_lines,\n qr_payload,\n)\nfrom .docx_utils import ReportBuilder\n\n__all__ = [\n \"AssetReportInputs\",\n \"build_asset_placard\",\n \"build_asset_record\",\n \"write_qr_png\",\n]\n\n#: Level H, so the symbol still reads after a season of mud and sunlight.\nPLACARD_ECC = \"H\"\n\n\ndef write_qr_png(text: str, out_path: str | Path, *, scale: int = 10,\n ecc: str = PLACARD_ECC) -> Path:\n \"\"\"Render ``text`` as a QR symbol on disk, and return where it went.\"\"\"\n path = Path(out_path)\n path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)\n path.write_bytes(qr.to_png(qr.encode(text, ecc=ecc), scale=scale))\n return path\n\n\n@dataclass\nclass AssetReportInputs:\n asset: Asset\n figures_dir: str | Path\n today: date | None = None\n schedule: Schedule | None = None\n prepared_by: str = \"\"\n readiness: Any = None\n\n\ndef _state(inputs: AssetReportInputs) -> AssetState:\n return asset_state(inputs.asset, inputs.today or date.today(),\n inputs.schedule)\n\n\ndef build_asset_placard(inputs: AssetReportInputs, out_path: str | Path,\n config: Config | None = None) -> Path:\n \"\"\"The page that gets fixed to the borehole.\"\"\"\n asset = inputs.asset\n rb = ReportBuilder(config.style if config else None,\n title=f\"Borehole {asset.asset_id}\")\n\n rb.paragraph(\"BOREHOLE IDENTIFICATION PLATE\", bold=True, align=\"center\")\n rb.paragraph(asset.asset_id, bold=True, size_pt=26, align=\"center\")\n rb.paragraph(asset.label, size_pt=13,
